S0118.or: O God, the loving guardian of virginity, by whose grace Your handmaid Margaret united to the beauty of virginity the merit of good works; grant, we beseech You, that in the spirit of saving penance we may be able to restore integrity of mind
S0118.se: We beseech You, O Lord, look mercifully on these offerings and, by the intercession of blessed Margaret, whom You willed to be made a victim of penance for the salvation of her people, be appeased and grant to the human race peace in the charity of Christ
S0118.pc: Refreshed, O Lord, at the heavenly table, we humbly beseech You that, by the example of blessed Margaret despising the fashion of this world which passes away, we may deserve to arrive at eternal joys

S0123.or: O God, who chose blessed Raymond to be a renowned minister of the sacrament of penance, and wondrously brought him across the waves of the sea; grant that through his intercession we may bring forth worthy fruits of penance and be able to reach the haven of eternal salvation
S0123.se: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts offered to Your majesty; and through the intercession of blessed Raymond, Your confessor, bestow on us the help of Your protection
S0123.pc: We beseech You, O Lord our God, that the feast of Saint Raymond, Your confessor, which we have celebrated, may obtain for us pardon of our sins and the glory of eternal happiness

S0125.or: O God, who taught the whole world by the preaching of blessed Paul the apostle; grant, we beseech You, that we who this day keep his conversion may come to You by following his example
S0125.se: Through the prayers of Your apostle Paul sanctify the gifts of Your people, O Lord; that what is pleasing to You by Your own institution may become yet more pleasing through the patronage of his pleading
S0125.pc: Hallowed by the saving mystery, O Lord, we beseech You that his prayers may never fail us, under whose patronage You have granted us to be governed

S0201.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who keep the feast of blessed Ignatius, Your martyr and bishop, may be helped by his intercession with You
S0201.se: May this victim, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse away our sins, and hallow the bodies and souls of Your servants for the offering of this sacrifice
S0201.pc: Refreshed by partaking of this sacred gift, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that through the intercession of blessed Ignatius, Your martyr and bishop, we may feel the effect of the rite we celebrate

S0205.or: O God, who among the other wonders of Your power have bestowed even on the weaker sex the victory of martyrdom; mercifully grant that we who keep the heavenly birthday of blessed Agatha, Your virgin and martyr, may come to You by following her example
S0205.se: Receive, O Lord, the gifts which we offer on the feast of blessed Agatha, Your virgin and martyr, by whose patronage we trust to be delivered
S0205.pc: May the mysteries received, O Lord, be a help to us; and through the intercession of blessed Agatha, Your virgin and martyr, may they strengthen us with unfailing protection

S0210.or: O God, who, to show forth the way of innocence, caused the soul of Your blessed virgin Scholastica to enter heaven in the likeness of a dove; grant us by her merits and prayers so to live in innocence that we may deserve to attain to eternal joys
S0210.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S0210.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S0213.or: O Lord Jesus Christ, who willed that blessed Catherine, Your virgin, on fire with Your love, should shine forth by the contemplation of Your passion; grant through her intercession that we, devoutly recalling the mysteries of Your passion, may deserve to gather its fruit
S0213.se: Make us, we beseech You, O Lord, partakers of Your holocaust offered on the altar of the cross, by the contemplation of which most holy mystery You made blessed Catherine, Your virgin, wonderful
S0213.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty and merciful God, that these pledges of ineffable love which we have received may inflame us to love You in return; and that by the intercession and example of blessed Catherine, Your virgin, we may ever live in Your love

S0214.or: O God, who made blessed Jordan wonderful in zeal for the salvation of souls and by the grace of spreading the Order; by his merits and intercession grant that we may always live in the same spirit and find the glory laid up for us in heaven
S0214.se: May blessed Jordan, O Lord, present in the sight of Your majesty the gift of the heavenly banquet which we offer; and vouchsafe that, as it brings him glory, so through his intercession it may become for us the pledge of the true way and of everlasting life
S0214.pc: May the hope of eternal salvation which You have willed us to have through receiving Your Body and Blood, O Lord, remain secure; and may the prayer of blessed Jordan ever be a saving intercession for us to win glory

S0309.or: O God, who among the other gifts of Your grace honored blessed Frances, Your handmaid, with the familiar companionship of an angel; grant, we beseech You, that by the help of her intercession we may deserve to attain the fellowship of the angels
S0309.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that through the holy pleading of blessed Frances they may become pleasing to You and salutary for us
S0309.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that through the glorious intercession of blessed Frances You would refresh with heavenly food those whom You have deigned to instruct by these saving mysteries

S0325.or: O God, who willed that Your Word, at the message of an angel, should take flesh in the womb of the blessed Virgin Mary; grant to Your suppliants that we who truly believe her to be the Mother of God may be helped by her intercession with You
S0325.se: Strengthen in our minds, we beseech You, O Lord, the mysteries of the true faith; that we who confess Him who was conceived of the Virgin to be true God and true man, may by the power of His saving resurrection deserve to attain eternal joy
S0325.pc: Pour forth, we beseech You, O Lord, Your grace into our hearts; that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ Your Son was made known by the message of an angel, may by His passion and cross be brought to the glory of His resurrection

S0405.or: O God, who by the wonderful preaching of blessed Vincent, Your confessor, brought a multitude of nations to the knowledge of Your name; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as our rewarder in heaven Him whom he proclaimed on earth as the Judge to come, our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son
S0405.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion; and that they may be pleasing to You and salutary for us, may blessed Vincent, Your confessor, who was glorious here by Your gifts, stand before Your mercy as our loving intercessor
S0405.pc: Filled with Your divine gifts, O Lord, we beseech You that through the glorious merits of blessed Vincent, Your confessor, we may feel the desired effect of the saving Victim

S0420.or: O God, who were pleased often to bedew blessed Agnes, Your virgin, with heavenly dew, and to adorn the places of her prayer with flowers of many kinds springing up; mercifully grant that through her prayers, sprinkled with the unfailing dew of Your blessing, we may deserve to receive the fruits of eternity
S0420.se: Be appeased, O Lord, by the gifts we offer; and as You were pleased to mark blessed Agnes, Your virgin, with the standard of the holy cross, so by her merits grant that we may be partakers of Your holocaust offered on the altar of the cross
S0420.pc: Hallowed by the offering of Your most holy Body and Blood, O Lord, grant that, the course of this life being joyfully finished, we may, through the intercession of blessed Agnes, a virgin most pleasing to You, deserve to enjoy eternal gladness

S0424.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who on earth venerate the crown of thorns of our Lord Jesus Christ in memory of His passion, may deserve to be crowned by Him with glory and honor in heaven
S0424.se: Strengthen the might of Your soldiers, O almighty King, that they whom the crown of Your only-begotten Son gladdens in the race of this mortal life may, when the course of the contest is finished, lay hold of the prize of immortality
S0424.pc: We humbly beseech You, almighty God, that these sacraments which we have received may, through the power of the most sacred crown of Your Son, whose feast we keep, avail us for healing

S0429.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may follow with fitting devotion the faith of blessed Peter, Your martyr, who for the spreading of that same faith merited to win the palm of martyrdom
S0429.se: Mercifully regard, O Lord, the prayers which we offer You through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your martyr; and keep under Your protection the champions of the faith
S0429.pc: Let the sacraments we have received safeguard Your faithful, O Lord; and through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your martyr, may they protect them against all hostile assaults

S0430.or: O God, who granted to blessed Catherine, adorned with the special privilege of virginity and patience, to overcome the assaults of evil spirits and to remain unshaken in the love of Your name; grant, we beseech You, that by imitating her we may trample on the wickedness of the world, overcome the snares of all our enemies, and pass safely to Your glory
S0430.se: Receive with kindly countenance, O Lord, we beseech You, the gifts we offer You in honor of blessed Catherine, Your virgin; and by her merits and intercession graciously bring us to Your joy
S0430.pc: Having received the sacraments of divine grace, O Lord, we beseech You that, through the intercession of blessed Catherine, a virgin most pleasing to You, we may overcome the assaults of the enemy, and, advancing toward the increase of eternal redemption, may ever be pleasing in Your sight

S0505.or: O God, who for the crushing of the enemies of Your Church and for the restoring of divine worship were pleased to choose blessed Pius as supreme Pontiff; grant that we may be defended by his protection and so cleave to Your service that, overcoming the snares of all our enemies, we may rejoice in everlasting peace
S0505.se: Receive, we beseech You, O Lord, the prayers and offerings of Your Church; that through the intercession of blessed Pius, Your confessor and pontiff, they may rise as an odor of sweetness in Your sight
S0505.pc: O Lord God, graciously pour forth the spirit of justice and fortitude upon Your faithful, whom You have deigned to protect from the assaults of all their enemies through the zeal and steadfastness of blessed Pius, Your confessor and pontiff

S0507.or: O God, for whose honor the glorious bishop Stanislaus fell beneath the swords of wicked men; grant, we beseech You, that all who implore his help may obtain the saving fruit of their petition
S0507.se: May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, and may it become salutary for us through the pleading of blessed Stanislaus, Your martyr and bishop, on whose feast it is offered
S0507.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of blessed Stanislaus, Your martyr and bishop, whose feast we celebrate

S0509.or: O God, who gave to Your people blessed Gregory as a minister of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as an intercessor in heaven him whom we had on earth as a teacher of life
S0509.se: Almighty and eternal God, through the intercession of blessed Gregory, Your confessor and bishop, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S0509.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may everywhere be helped by the prayer of blessed Gregory, Your confessor and bishop, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

S0518.or: O God, who have consecrated this day by the triumph of blessed Venantius, Your martyr; hear the prayers of Your people, and grant that we who venerate his merits may imitate the constancy of his faith
S0518.se: May the merits of blessed Venantius, Your martyr, make this offering acceptable to You, almighty God; that, helped by his aid, we may be made sharers of his glory
S0518.pc: We have received, O Lord, the sacraments of eternal life, and humbly beseech You that, blessed Venantius, Your martyr, pleading for us, they may obtain for us pardon and grace

S0519.or: O God, who raised blessed Peter Celestine to the height of the supreme pontificate, and taught him to set it aside for the sake of humility; mercifully grant that by his example we may despise all things of the world and happily deserve to attain the rewards promised to the humble
S0519.se: May Your saints, we beseech You, O Lord, everywhere make us glad; that while we recall their merits we may feel their patronage
S0519.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that giving thanks for the gifts we have received, we may, through the intercession of blessed Peter Celestine, Your confessor and pontiff, receive still greater benefits

S0526.or: O God, who raised blessed Philip, Your confessor, to the glory of Your saints; mercifully grant that we who rejoice in his feast may profit by the example of his virtues
S0526.se: Look graciously, O Lord, we beseech You, upon these present sacrifices, and grant that the Holy Spirit may enkindle us with that fire with which He wondrously pierced the heart of blessed Philip
S0526.pc: Fed with heavenly delights, O Lord, we beseech You that by the merits and imitation of blessed Philip, Your confessor, we may ever seek after those things by which we truly live

S0604.or: O God, who adorned blessed Francis, founder of a new Order, with zeal for prayer and love of penance; grant to Your servants so to advance in imitating him that, praying always and bringing the body into subjection, they may deserve to attain heavenly glory
S0604.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0604.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Francis, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0614.or: O God, who gave to Your people blessed Basil as a minister of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as an intercessor in heaven him whom we had on earth as a teacher of life
S0614.se: May the yearly feast of Saint Basil, Your confessor and bishop, make us acceptable to Your loving kindness, O Lord, we beseech You; that by these offices of holy propitiation a blessed reward may attend him, and the gifts of Your grace may be won for us
S0614.pc: O God, the rewarder of faithful souls, grant that through the prayers of blessed Basil, Your confessor and bishop, whose venerable feast we celebrate, we may obtain pardon

S0702.or: Almighty and merciful God, we humbly entreat Your majesty that, as You revealed Your only-begotten Son to the child enclosed in the womb through the visitation and greeting of His Mother, so by the merits and prayers of the same Mother You would grant us to contemplate Him for ever with unveiled face
S0702.se: Almighty and eternal God, who ever have care of all who trust in You; grant, we beseech You, that through the offering which we make to You we may always feel in our needs the spiritual visitation of the blessed Virgin Mary
S0702.pc: Almighty and eternal God, who willed that the commemoration of the Visitation of most blessed Mary, Mother of God, should be kept; grant, we beseech You, that through this sacrifice which we have received we may never fall away from the grace of her visitation

S0709.or: O God, who crowned with the laurel of eternity the glorious struggle for Your faith of Your blessed martyrs John and his companions; mercifully grant that, striving on earth by their merits and imitation, we may deserve to be crowned with them in heaven
S0709.se: Look down, O Lord, from Your sanctuary and from the lofty dwelling place of heaven upon the sacrifice which we offer; and, the blood of Your holy martyrs crying out, may our hearts glow with the fire of charity, and our prayers rise to You as an odor of sweetness
S0709.pc: O God, author and giver of strength, grant through the faith and constancy of Your holy martyrs that we who approach the sacred banquet may be kindled with the same ardor with which they offered their lives to You as a holocaust for the truth of Your Body and Blood

S0711.or: O God, who willed that the lands of Annam should be watered by the blood of the blessed bishops Ignatius and Dominic and their companions; through the intercession of these great martyrs make them flourish with the Christian religion
S0711.se: Almighty God, author and giver of fortitude, sanctify the gifts offered to Your majesty; and through the intercession of the blessed martyrs whose feast we celebrate today, heal the weaknesses of our hearts
S0711.pc: May Your sacraments, O Lord, we beseech You, give us that constancy with which they nourished the blessed martyrs unto victory

S0718.or: O God, who adorned blessed Camillus with a singular gift of charity for the help of souls struggling in their last agony; by his merits, we beseech You, pour into us the spirit of Your love, that in the hour of our death we may overcome the enemy and deserve to attain the heavenly crown
S0718.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0718.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Camillus, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0722.or: Grant us, most merciful Father, that as blessed Mary Magdalen, by loving our Lord Jesus Christ above all things, obtained pardon of her sins, so she may obtain for us everlasting happiness from Your mercy
S0722.se: O God, awesome and most loving, may blessed Mary Magdalen enrich this victim of our offering with the increase of her prayers, and ask that it may avail for our healing
S0722.pc: May the sacred outpouring of the divine gift, O Lord, we beseech You, sanctify and protect us through the intercession of blessed Mary Magdalen, and make us co-heirs with the heavenly powers

S0726.or: O God, who raised blessed Anne, the mother of Your Mother, to the joys of heavenly life; grant, we beseech You, that by her glorious merits we may attain to eternal happiness, You who from her saving offspring deigned to take human nature for the salvation of the world
S0726.se: Accept, O Lord, the gifts devoutly offered, and grant that through the pleading merits of blessed Anne they may avail for the help of our salvation
S0726.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may everywhere be helped by the prayer of blessed Anne, mother of the most blessed Virgin Mary, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

S0802.or: O God, who through blessed Alphonsus Mary, Your confessor and bishop, on fire with zeal for souls, enriched Your Church with a new offspring; we beseech You that, taught by his saving counsels and strengthened by his example, we may happily come to You
S0802.se: O Lord Jesus Christ, burn our hearts with the heavenly fire of the sacrifice unto an odor of sweetness, You who granted blessed Alphonsus Mary both to celebrate these mysteries and through them to offer himself to You as a holy victim
S0802.pc: O God, who made blessed Alphonsus Mary, Your confessor and bishop, a faithful dispenser and herald of the divine mystery; grant by his merits and prayers that Your faithful may receive it often, and, receiving it, praise You without end

S0804.or: O God, who were pleased to enlighten Your Church by the merits and teaching of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father; grant that through his intercession she may not be deprived of temporal help, and may ever grow in spiritual increase
S0804.se: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts dedicated to You; that by the merits of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father, they may avail us for healing
S0804.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who are weighed down by the burden of our sins may be raised up by the patronage of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father

S0806.or: O God, who in the glorious Transfiguration of Your only-begotten Son confirmed the mysteries of the faith by the testimony of the fathers, and by the voice that came from the bright cloud wondrously foreshowed the perfect adoption of sons; mercifully grant that You may make us co-heirs of the King of glory Himself, and grant us to be sharers of that same glory
S0806.se: Sanctify, we beseech You, O Lord, the gifts offered, through the glorious Transfiguration of Your only-begotten Son, and cleanse us from the stains of sin by the splendor of His brightness
S0806.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may attain with the understanding of a purified mind the sacred mysteries of the Transfiguration of Your Son, which we celebrate with solemn office

S0817.or: O God, who made blessed Hyacinth, Your confessor, renowned among the peoples of many nations by the holiness of his works and the glory of his miracles; grant that we may be reformed for the better by his example and protected in adversity by his help
S0817.se: Through the intercession of Your most worthy Mother, may blessed Hyacinth, who walked fearless upon the waters, bring these sacred offerings before the sight of Your divine majesty, O Lord; and do You graciously deign to accept them, brought for our salvation
S0817.pc: We beseech You, O Lord, that those whom You have refreshed with the ineffable sweetness of Your Body and Blood, helped by the loving prayers of blessed Hyacinth, You would bring to eternal joy

S0821.or: Almighty and merciful God, who endowed blessed Jane Frances, on fire with Your love, with wonderful strength of spirit along every path of life in the way of perfection, and willed through her to enrich Your Church with a new offspring; grant by her merits and prayers that we who, conscious of our weakness, trust in Your strength, may by the help of heavenly grace overcome all that is against us
S0821.se: May this saving victim, we beseech You, O Lord, inflame us with that fire of love with which it vehemently kindled the heart of blessed Jane Frances and seared it with the flames of eternal charity
S0821.pc: Pour into us, O Lord, the spirit of Your charity, that, through the intercession of blessed Jane Frances, You would make those whom You have filled with the strength of the heavenly bread despise the things of earth and follow You alone, the true God, with a pure mind

S0827.or: O God, who through Saint Joseph, Your confessor, were pleased to provide a new help for Your Church in forming the young in the spirit of understanding and piety; grant, we beseech You, that by his example and intercession we may so act and teach as to obtain eternal rewards
S0827.se: We load Your altar, O Lord, with the gifts we offer; that they may become pleasing to You through the pleading of him by whose patronage You have granted us to be helped
S0827.pc: Hallowed by the saving mystery, O Lord, we beseech You that, through the intercession of Saint Joseph, Your confessor, we may ever advance to a greater increase of piety

S0829.or: May the venerable feast of Saint John the Baptist, Your precursor and martyr, O Lord, we beseech You, obtain for us the effect of saving help
S0829.se: We offer You gifts, O Lord, for the passion of Your holy martyr John the Baptist; and we beseech You that at his pleading they may avail us unto salvation
S0829.pc: May the blessed feast of Saint John the Baptist, O Lord, obtain for us that we may both venerate the great sacraments we have received in what they signify, and rejoice rather in what they bring about in us

S0830.or: Almighty God, bestower of all good things, who willed that blessed Rose, prevented by the dew of heavenly grace, should flower among the Indians in the beauty of virginity and patience; grant to us Your servants that, running in the odor of her sweetness, we may deserve to become the good odor of Christ
S0830.se: May the sacrifices of praise which we humbly offer You, O Lord, steeped in the fragrance of blessed Rose, Your virgin, be acceptable to You; that they may bring her honor, and become for us a propitiation unto salvation
S0830.pc: May our prayers rise to You, O Lord, fragrant with the sweetness of blessed Rose, Your virgin; that, refreshed in time with the food of heaven, we may enjoy the sweetness of the eternal banquet

S0908.or: Mercifully hear, O God, the supplication of Your servants, that we who are gathered together on the Nativity of the Virgin Mother of God may by her intercession be delivered by You from the dangers that threaten us
S0908.se: May the humanity of Your only-begotten Son, O Lord, come to our aid; that He who, born of the Virgin, did not lessen but hallowed His Mother's integrity, may on the feast of her Nativity free us from our sins and make our offering acceptable to You, Jesus Christ our Lord
S0908.pc: We have received, O Lord, the votive sacraments of this yearly feast; grant, we beseech You, that they may bring us remedies for this temporal life and for the life eternal

S0916.or: Mercifully regard our weakness, O Lord, we beseech You, and through the intercession of Your holy martyrs and bishops Cornelius and Cyprian turn away from us all the evils which we justly deserve
S0916.se: Look graciously, O Lord, upon the gifts of Your people, which are dedicated to Your majesty on the feast of Your holy martyrs and bishops Cornelius and Cyprian
S0916.pc: Filled with the saving mysteries, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may be helped by the prayers of those whose feast we celebrate

S0918.or: O God, who willed that blessed John, Your confessor, prevented by the abundance of Your grace, should flourish in a lowly state of life by the purity of his ways; grant us, we beseech You, so to follow in his footsteps that we may deserve to come to You with pure minds
S0918.se: We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in honor of blessed John, Your confessor, who for the salvation of the faithful continually offered himself to Your majesty as a victim of penance
S0918.pc: Grant, almighty God, that we who are refreshed with the bread of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed John, Your confessor, ever grow in Your love, You who gave him purity of life and perfect charity

S0919.or: O God, who gladden us by the yearly feast of Your holy martyrs Januarius and his companions; mercifully grant that we who rejoice in their merits may be kindled by their example
S0919.se: Be appeased, we beseech You, O Lord, by the gifts we offer; and through the intercession of Your holy martyrs Januarius and his companions defend us from all dangers
S0919.pc: May this communion, O Lord, cleanse us from guilt, and through the intercession of Your holy martyrs Januarius and his companions make us sharers in the heavenly remedy

S0921.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable feast of blessed Matthew, Your apostle and evangelist, which we anticipate, may increase in us both devotion and salvation
S0921.se: Offering You the sacred mysteries in reverence of the apostolic dignity, we beseech You, O Lord, that through the prayers of blessed Matthew, Your apostle and evangelist, whose heavenly birthday we anticipate, Your people may ever both pour forth their prayers and obtain what they desire
S0921.pc: Appeased, O Lord, we beseech You, by the supplication of Your holy apostle and evangelist Matthew, grant us pardon and bestow on us everlasting remedies

S1005.or: O God, who willed that blessed Raymond, Your confessor, should be an eminent master of evangelical perfection and a faithful defender of apostolic authority; mercifully grant that we who live on earth after his example may deserve to be crowned with him in heaven
S1005.se: Through this offering and the intercession of blessed Raymond, Your confessor, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that despising earthly things we may ever set our thoughts on the things of heaven
S1005.pc: Having received the mysteries of Your Body and Blood, O Lord, we humbly entreat You that, through the intercession of Your servant Raymond, we may, after the dangers of this life, attain eternal joys in heaven

S1008.or: O Lord our God, who through Your only-begotten Son revealed heavenly secrets to blessed Bridget; grant to us Your servants, through her loving intercession, to rejoice with gladness in the revelation of Your everlasting glory
S1008.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S1008.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S1009.or: O God, who by mortification of the body and the preaching of the faith made blessed Louis, Your confessor, equal to the glory of the saints; grant that what we profess by faith we may ever fulfil by works of piety
S1009.se: We offer You, O God, the sacrifice of this sacred table, prepared for us by the King of kings, Jesus Christ; and through the pleading merits of blessed Louis grant us to draw from it our help and consolation
S1009.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty and merciful God, that we who celebrate the merits of blessed Louis may also imitate his virtues, and by imitating may advance, and by advancing may be able to come with him to the heavenly kingdom

S1014.or: O God, who see that we fail through our own weakness; mercifully restore us to Your love by the example of Your saints
S1014.se: May the mystical offering, O Lord, profit us, that it may both free us from our sins and confirm us in everlasting salvation
S1014.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that the sacred gifts may cleanse our guilt and bring about in us the effect of right living

S1015.or: Hear us, O God our Savior, that as we rejoice in the feast of blessed Teresa, Your virgin, so we may be nourished by the food of her heavenly teaching and taught by the affection of loving devotion
S1015.se: May our devotion, we beseech You, O Lord, be acceptable to Your majesty through the prayers of blessed Teresa, to whom the inmost holocaust of her heart was so pleasing
S1015.pc: We beseech You, O Lord our God, that Your household, subject to You, which You have fed with the bread of heaven, may through the intercession and example of blessed Teresa be able to sing Your mercies for ever

S1018.or: May Your holy evangelist Luke intercede for us, we beseech You, O Lord, who for the love of Your name ever bore in his body the mortification of the cross
S1018.se: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, through these heavenly gifts, to serve You with a free mind; that the gifts which we offer may, through the intercession of blessed Luke, Your evangelist, work in us both healing and glory
S1018.pc: Filled, O Lord, with heavenly blessing, we humbly entreat You that what we celebrate with our frail service we may feel to profit us through the help of blessed Luke, Your evangelist

S1101.or: Almighty and eternal God, who have granted us to venerate in one solemn feast the merits of all Your saints; we beseech You that, with our intercessors multiplied, You would bestow on us the longed-for abundance of Your mercy
S1101.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion; may they be pleasing to You in honor of all the saints, and by Your mercy become salutary for us
S1101.pc: Grant to Your faithful people, we beseech You, O Lord, ever to rejoice in the veneration of all the saints, and to be defended by their unceasing supplication

S1105.or: O God, the exaltation of the humble, who caused blessed Martin, Your confessor, to pass to the heavenly kingdom; grant by his merits and intercession that we may so imitate his humility on earth as to deserve to be exalted with him in heaven
S1105.se: Graciously receive, O Lord, this victim which we offer to be consecrated to You in honor of blessed Martin, Your confessor; and grant that through his loving intercession it may bring us the effect of Your salvation
S1105.pc: Nourished with heavenly food, we humbly beseech You, O Lord our God, that, blessed Martin, Your confessor, interceding for us, we may ever be able to obey Your commandments

S1106.or: O God, who were pleased to make Your Church fruitful by the blood of the blessed martyrs Jerome, Valentine, Francis, Hyacinth and their companions; mercifully grant that we who joyfully recall their triumphs may be helped by their prayers and merits
S1106.se: Look graciously, O Lord, we beseech You, upon these present sacrifices; that through the intercession of Your blessed martyrs they may profit our devotion and our salvation
S1106.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that the feast of Your blessed martyrs Jerome, Valentine, Francis, Hyacinth and their companions, celebrated with heavenly mysteries, may obtain for us the pardon of Your mercy

S1119.or: Enlighten, O God of mercy, the hearts of Your faithful; and through the glorious prayers of blessed Elizabeth make us despise the prosperity of this world and ever rejoice in heavenly consolation
S1119.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that through the loving pleading of blessed Elizabeth they may become pleasing to You and salutary for us
S1119.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that through the glorious intercession of blessed Elizabeth You would refresh with heavenly food those whom You have deigned to instruct by these saving mysteries

S1121.or: O God, who willed that blessed Mary ever Virgin, the dwelling place of the Holy Spirit, should on this day be presented in the temple; grant, we beseech You, that through her intercession we may deserve to be presented in the temple of Your glory
S1121.se: May the humanity of Your only-begotten Son, O Lord, come to our aid; that He who, born of the Virgin, did not lessen but hallowed His Mother's integrity, may on her feast free us from our sins and make our offering acceptable to You, Jesus Christ our Lord
S1121.pc: We have received, O Lord, the votive sacraments of this yearly feast; grant, we beseech You, that they may bring us remedies for this temporal life and for the life eternal

S1123.or: O God, who gladden us by the yearly feast of blessed Clement, Your martyr and bishop; mercifully grant that we who keep his heavenly birthday may also imitate the fortitude of his passion
S1123.se: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts offered to You; and through the intercession of blessed Clement, Your martyr and bishop, cleanse us by them from the stains of our sins
S1123.pc: Filled with the offering of the sacred Body and precious Blood, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that what we perform with loving devotion we may, through the intercession of blessed Clement, Your martyr and bishop, receive as sure redemption

S1203.or: O God, who willed to gather the peoples of the Indies into Your Church by the preaching and miracles of blessed Francis; mercifully grant that we who venerate his glorious merits may also imitate the example of his virtues
S1203.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S1203.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Francis, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0102b.or: O God, who wondrously made blessed Stephana, Your virgin, on fire with love of the Crucified, a sharer in His passion; grant, we beseech You, that by her intercession and example we may deserve to be conformed to the image of Your Son
S0102b.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S0102b.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S0116b.or: O God, who wondrously inflamed the mind of blessed Gonsalvo, Your confessor, with love of Your holy name; grant, we beseech You, that clinging to his footsteps we may ever think of You, and do with burning zeal the things that are pleasing to You
S0116b.se: We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in commemoration of Your saints, through whom we trust to be delivered from evils both present and to come
S0116b.pc: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of him in whose commemoration we have received these gifts

S0119b.or: O Lord Jesus Christ, who adorned blessed Andrew, Your confessor, with an apostolic spirit; grant that by imitating him we may so advance in word and example as to bring forth abundant fruit
S0119b.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0119b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Andrew, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0124b.or: O God, to whom the prayer of the humble and meek has always been pleasing; grant that we may so profit by the prayers and example of blessed Marcolinus that, made truly meek and humble of heart, we may the more readily receive Your gifts
S0124b.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0124b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Marcolinus, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0130b.or: O God, who, preventing blessed Mary with the abundance of Your grace, made her wonderful by the gift of contemplation and by surpassing charity toward her neighbor; grant us by imitating her that, meditating on heavenly things and showing mercy to others, we may deserve to attain eternal glory with her
S0130b.se: May Your mercy, O God, through the intercession of blessed Mary, graciously wipe away in us the stains of all our sins; that, purified in mind and body, we may worthily offer You the holy victim
S0130b.pc: Fed with heavenly food and refreshed by the sacrament of love, we humbly beseech You, O Lord, that through the merits of blessed Mary You would free our hearts from earthly desires and kindle them with the fire of Your charity

S0216b.or: Graciously pour into us, O God, the spirit of blessed Nicholas, Your confessor; that, as You adorned him with singular grace in preaching Your word and in procuring the salvation of his neighbors, so by his prayers You may make us remain steadfast in the same holy calling
S0216b.se: Sanctify, we beseech You, O Lord, the gift offered; and, mercifully made a worthy victim by the merits and example of blessed Nicholas, may we ever be fervent in heart and effective in deed
S0216b.pc: May this communion, O Lord, make us partakers of the sacred gift; and, ever following in the footsteps of blessed Nicholas, Your confessor, may we deserve to be crowned with him in heaven

S0219b.or: O God, who signally adorned blessed Alvarez, Your confessor, with the gifts of charity and penance; grant that by his intercession and example we may ever bear the mortification of Christ in our body and the love of You in our heart
S0219b.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0219b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Alvarez, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0301b.or: O God, who made blessed Christopher, Your confessor, a worthy servant to You; grant by his merits and imitation that we may be able to bear Christ within us with the whole intent of our mind and the affection of our heart
S0301b.se: May this victim, we beseech You, O Lord, which we offer You in honor of blessed Christopher, Your confessor, avail for the help of our salvation
S0301b.pc: Refreshed with saving food, we entreat You, O Lord, that, blessed Christopher interceding for us, You would deign to lead us to the heavenly banquet

S0322b.or: Almighty and eternal God, who by the light of Your wisdom dispel the darkness of ignorance; through the merits and prayers of blessed Isnard, Your confessor, increase the strength of our faith, that the fire which Your grace has kindled may be quenched by no temptations
S0322b.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gift to be consecrated, by which, recalling the merits of blessed Isnard, Your faithful servant, we also implore purification for our minds
S0322b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that the holy gifts may cleanse our guilt, and, through the intercession of blessed Isnard, Your confessor, bring about in us the effect of right living

S0323b.or: O God, who willed to enlighten with the wondrous brightness of Your light the mind of blessed Sibyllina, Your virgin, deprived of bodily sight; grant us through her intercession that, enlightened by the light from above, we may despise the things of earth and effectively seek the things eternal
S0323b.se: Receive, O Lord, the offering we make to You, and through the intercession of blessed Sibyllina grant that, as she devoutly venerated on earth the mysteries of Your Son's passion, so we may deserve to obtain their fruit
S0323b.pc: May the mysteries of Your Body and Blood which we have received, O Lord, through the intercession of blessed Sibyllina make us effective in works of virtue and fervent in Your love

S0409b.or: O God, who for the furthering of the unity of the faith bestowed on blessed Anthony, Your martyr, an unconquered strength of soul; grant us, we beseech You, so to follow in his footsteps that we may obtain the end of our faith, the salvation of our souls
S0409b.se: Graciously accept, O Lord, the sacrifice which we offer You in honor of blessed Anthony, Your martyr, that You may deliver Your Church from all the wickedness of heretics and establish her in the safety of Your protection
S0409b.pc: O Lord Jesus, who at this heavenly table strengthened blessed Anthony for the contest of martyrdom; grant us by his intercession, in the strength of the same food, to overcome all the enemies of our salvation and happily to come to eternal joys

S0413b.or: O God, who willed that blessed Margaret, Your virgin, should be born without sight, so that, the eye of her heart being enlightened within, she might contemplate You alone without ceasing; be the light of our eyes, by which we may be free from the darkness of this world and come to the homeland of eternal brightness
S0413b.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S0413b.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S0414b.or: O God, who show the singular help of blessed Peter to those placed in the perils of the sea; grant us through his intercession that in the storms of this life the light of Your grace may ever shine upon us, by which we may be able to find the haven of eternal salvation
S0414b.se: Be merciful to us, O our God, that through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your confessor, You may join to the ranks of the blessed those whom You refresh with saving sacraments
S0414b.pc: Enlighten our hearts, we beseech You, O Lord, with the light of Your brightness; that, taught by the word of salvation, through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your confessor, we may avoid all that is harmful and be able to do what is right

S0417b.or: Grant us, merciful God, the spirit of prayer and penance; that, clinging to the footsteps of blessed Clare, we may deserve to obtain the crown which she has received in heaven
S0417b.se: O God, who willed to redeem the world through Your only-begotten Son on the altar of the cross; grant that while we offer Him in sacrifice, we may, through the merits of blessed Clare, be strengthened in the confidence of our eternal salvation
S0417b.pc: O God, who have deigned to make us partakers of this spiritual banquet; grant us through the intercession of blessed Clare so to live that we may be able to attain to the eternal banquet

S0422b.or: O God, who made blessed Bartholomew a renowned champion of the faith and exalted him with the crown of martyrdom; grant us by his merits and intercession ever to bear the cross, that with him we may deserve to be sharers of Your glory
S0422b.se: O most merciful Jesus, may the holy intercession of blessed Bartholomew commend our offering to You, who, upheld by faith and charity, feared not to lose his life for You and for the Gospel, that he might find life eternal
S0422b.pc: May the gift of the divine sacrament which has been offered purify us, we beseech You, O Lord, and through the intercession of blessed Bartholomew, martyr, strengthen us in the light of Your truth

S0426b.or: O God, whose mercies are without number, we humbly beseech You that, through the intercession of blessed Dominic and Gregory, Your confessors, being freed from the burden of our sins, we may attain the glory which they have obtained
S0426b.se: Look graciously, O Lord, upon the offering which we make to You, and through the merits of blessed Dominic and Gregory grant that we may present ourselves to You as an acceptable victim
S0426b.pc: We beseech You, O Lord our God, that the sacred mysteries which we have received may, through the intercession of blessed Dominic and Gregory, be for us a sure defense against all evils to come

S0512b.or: O God, who amid the delights of a royal court and the allurements of the world strengthened blessed Joan, Your virgin, with the virtue of constancy; grant, we beseech You, that through her intercession Your faithful may despise the things of earth and ever aspire to the things of heaven
S0512b.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S0512b.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S0514b.or: We humbly implore Your mercy, O God, that as by its prevenient grace You caused blessed Giles to return to the way of justice and holiness, so You would bring us out of the slavery and death of sin into perfect freedom and life
S0514b.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0514b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Giles, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0517b.or: O God, who granted to blessed Andrew, Your confessor, to preach the Gospel of peace in deed and word; through his intercession, we beseech You, make us receive Your law with a perfect heart and fulfil it by holy living
S0517b.se: Grant, most holy Father, that we may worthily offer to You the spotless Victim which blessed Andrew used to sacrifice with pure hands
S0517b.pc: May the Sacrament of Your Body and Blood, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse us from every stain, and through the intercession of blessed Andrew, Your confessor, ever work holiness in us

S0520b.or: O God, who deigned to enlighten with heavenly splendors blessed Columba, Your virgin, shining white with purity and innocence; grant, we beseech You, that by her intercession, serving You with pure minds on earth, we may deserve to enjoy the splendor of Your glory in heaven
S0520b.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S0520b.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S0528b.or: O God, lover of souls, who in blessed Mary Bartholomew, Your virgin, joined a wondrous endurance of sickness with equal innocence; grant that we who are afflicted by the desert of our deeds may breathe again in the consolation of Your grace
S0528b.se: Offering You, O Lord, the Bread of Angels and the wine that brings forth virgins, through the intercession of blessed Mary Bartholomew, Your virgin, free us from all defilement, that we may deserve to be placed for ever among the pure ranks of the Angels
S0528b.pc: Pour forth upon us, O Lord Jesus, the grace of Your mercy, and grant that, through the intercession of blessed Mary Bartholomew, Your virgin, we may be delivered from all adversities, and, persevering in Your service, may be able to attain eternal joy

S0530b.or: O God, who willed that blessed Andrew, Your confessor and bishop, should excel in piety and learning in the preaching of Your word and in the office of a good shepherd; grant us through his intercession that, striving courageously in Your holy service, we may deserve to bring forth abundant fruit
S0530b.se: Through this spotless victim we humbly entreat You, O Lord, that through the intercession of blessed Andrew we may be able to offer ourselves to You as a pleasing victim
S0530b.pc: May the reception of Your precious Body and Blood, O Lord, add such strength to us that, by the prayers and example of blessed Andrew, we may ever be made conformable to Your divine will

S0605b.or: O God, who gladden us by the yearly feast of blessed James, Your confessor; mercifully grant that we who keep his heavenly birthday may also imitate his deeds
S0605b.se: We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in commemoration of Your saints, through whom we trust to be delivered from evils both present and to come
S0605b.pc: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of him in whose commemoration we have received these gifts

S0612b.or: O God, who, to call back wandering believers to the way of salvation, made blessed Stephen, Your confessor, an outstanding minister of Gospel preaching; grant by his merits and intercession that, set free from all sins, we may ever run the path of Your commandments
S0612b.se: Receive, most merciful God, the gifts reverently offered to You; and, You who through blessed Stephen, Your confessor, caused many who were straying to return to the way of justice and holiness, mercifully turn our rebellious wills also to You
S0612b.pc: Refreshed by ineffable sacraments, we beseech Your mercy, almighty God, that we who celebrate the illustrious merits of blessed Stephen, Your confessor, may through his intercession attain the eternal joys promised in these mysteries

S0723b.or: O God, who heaped heavenly gifts upon the surpassing purity and fervent charity of blessed Joan, Your virgin; make us so emulate her virtues that by chastity of life and purity of affection we may ever be pleasing to You
S0723b.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S0723b.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S0724b.or: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord Jesus, by the merits and imitation of blessed Augustine, Your confessor, so to quench the desires of the flesh by penance that we may ever grow in Your grace and knowledge
S0724b.se: Grant us, almighty God, to consecrate the spotless victim to You with that affection of burning devotion with which blessed Augustine, Your confessor, glowed in offering it; that, serving Your majesty worthily, we may obtain the longed-for gifts of Your pardon
S0724b.pc: Refreshed with the bread of Angels, most merciful God, may the saving example and loving intercession of blessed Augustine, Your confessor, ever rouse us to praise Your infinite goodness until death, and at last, in perfect charity, to continue that praise in an everlasting song in heaven

S0728b.or: O God, who set blessed Anthony, Your confessor, on fire with divine love; kindle in our hearts, we beseech You, through his intercession, the fire of Your charity, that loving You on earth we may enjoy eternal joys in heaven
S0728b.se: Through these sacred gifts which we offer, O Lord, protect Your servants; and those whom the glory of blessed Anthony gladdens, make devoted to You in mind and body
S0728b.pc: Refreshed by the mystery of Your Body and Blood, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may be numbered in the homeland with blessed Anthony, by whose example we are drawn to You on the way

S0803b.or: O God, who were pleased to provide for Your Church in blessed Augustine, Your confessor and bishop, the example of a good shepherd; mercifully grant that through his intercession we may deserve to be placed for ever in the place of Your pasture
S0803b.se: May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, and may it become salutary for us through the pleading of him on whose feast it is offered
S0803b.pc: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, to Your faithful ever to rejoice in the veneration of Your saints, and to be defended by their unceasing intercession

S0811b.or: O God, who for the increase of the faith made blessed John, Your confessor, an outstanding herald of Your word; grant us through his intercession that what we believe with the heart unto justice we may confess with the mouth unto salvation
S0811b.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0811b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed John, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0818b.or: Almighty and merciful God, whom to serve is to reign; through the merits and intercession of blessed Aimo, Your confessor, whom You made an outstanding champion of the faith, grant that, faithfully serving Your commandments on earth, we may deserve to enjoy the eternal kingdom with him in heaven
S0818b.se: Be appeased, O Lord, by the gifts we offer, and through the intercession of blessed Aimo, Your confessor, mercifully stretch forth Your almighty right hand to defend Your Church; that, all adversities and errors being destroyed, she may rejoice in the longed-for unity of faith and in peace
S0818b.pc: O Lord Jesus, good Shepherd, who for the furthering of the unity of Your Church willed all Your sheep to be partakers of the one heavenly banquet; grant, we beseech You, that through the pleading merits of blessed Aimo, Your confessor, there may ever be in Your flock one faith of minds and one devotion of deeds

S0823b.or: O God, who by the wondrous sprinkling of Your Blood deigned to strengthen blessed James, Your confessor, with sure confidence of eternal salvation; open wide over us the same tender mercy, that, marked with the seal of our redemption, we may be numbered for ever among the sheep at Your right hand
S0823b.se: We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in commemoration of Your saints, through whom we trust to be delivered from evils both present and to come
S0823b.pc: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of him in whose commemoration we have received these gifts

S0904b.or: O Lord our hope, who adorned with the abundance of heavenly gifts the heart of blessed Catherine, filled with Yourself; grant through the intercession of so great a virgin that He may be wholly fixed in our hearts who for us was wholly fixed to the cross, our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son
S0904b.se: Not unaware, O Lord, of our sins, we dare to approach the awesome table of Your Lamb, upheld by the remembrance of the merits of Catherine, His bride; reject not, we beseech You, the desires of sighing souls, but, appeased by the present offering and feast, make us partakers of so wonderful a holiness
S0904b.pc: O Lord Jesus, bread of life, who at this table served Your virgin Catherine with a feast of unfailing sweetness; be merciful to us wretched sinners, that we may be filled with the crumbs that fall from so great an abundance

S0905b.or: O God, who, to establish Your people in peace and piety, adorned blessed Guala, Your confessor and bishop, with singular grace; grant us through his intercession that, zealously pursuing peace, we may gather abundant fruits of piety
S0905b.se: Through the offering of this spotless victim and the intercession of blessed Guala, Your confessor, O Lord, bestow on us the gifts of Your peace
S0905b.pc: Refreshed with the bread of life, we entreat You, O Lord, that through the intercession of blessed Guala, bishop and confessor, You would make us so to live always that at our departure we may be able to ascend to You

S0923b.or: O God, who through blessed Mark, Your confessor, caused very many who were straying to return to the way of justice; grant that through his intercession we also, set free from our vices, may happily be able to attain eternal joys
S0923b.se: Receive, most merciful Lord, this spotless victim, and through the merits of blessed Mark, Your confessor, deign to pour forth upon us the tender depths of Your mercy
S0923b.pc: Refreshed with the bread of Angels, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may follow the counsels and example of blessed Mark, Your confessor, and be fortified by constant meditation on the cross

S0926b.or: O God, who adorned Your humble servant Dalmatius with many signs and virtues, and, earthly things being despised, wondrously inflamed him with Your love; grant us, we beseech You, that through his intercession, freed from earthly affections and delivered from all adversities, we may seek heavenly things alone
S0926b.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0926b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Dalmatius, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S1011b.or: O God, who wondrously adorned blessed James, Your confessor, with the virtue of humility and obedience; through his intercession make us despise the things of earth and ever cleave to Your commandments
S1011b.se: Be appeased, O Lord, by the gifts we offer, and through the intercession of blessed James, Your confessor, grant that, worthily receiving the heavenly gifts, we may deserve to obtain the rewards promised to the humble
S1011b.pc: We humbly entreat You, O Lord, that the Bread of Angels, of which You make us partakers, may through the merits of blessed James be for us an unfailing hope and a secure enjoyment of eternal salvation

S1013b.or: O God, who forsake no one who hopes in You and mercifully hear those who devoutly pray; grant, we beseech You, that what we cannot obtain by our own merits we may obtain through the patronage of blessed Magdalen, Your virgin
S1013b.se: May this victim, O Lord, which we offer before the throne of Your divine majesty, be made propitiatory for us through the blessed virgin Magdalen, and render us fit ever to merit heavenly gifts
S1013b.pc: May the sacred gifts we have received draw us away from future excesses, and, through the glorious intercession of blessed Magdalen, Your virgin, may they make us, who have been made partakers of the divine nature, fervent in heart and effective in deed

S1021b.or: O God, who foretold that Your faithful who remember their last end would never sin; grant us, through the prayers and example of blessed Peter, Your confessor, so to meditate on temporal death that, ever weeping for the sins we have committed, we may escape eternal death
S1021b.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S1021b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S1023b.or: O God, who made blessed Bartholomew, Your confessor and bishop, wonderful in leading the enemies of the faith from the darkness of error to the light of truth, and in recalling peoples to peace and concord; grant through his intercession that Your peace, which surpasses all understanding, may keep our hearts and minds in Christ Jesus our Lord
S1023b.se: May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, and may it become salutary for us through the pleading of him on whose feast it is offered
S1023b.pc: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, to Your faithful ever to rejoice in the veneration of Your saints, and to be defended by their unceasing intercession

S1026b.or: O God, who, for procuring the salvation of the faithful, adorned blessed Damian, Your confessor, both with a wondrous power of speech and with virtues; grant, we beseech You, that by his intercession and example we may show true charity in word and deed
S1026b.se: Receive, O Lord, this victim which we offer to You, and by the merits of blessed Damian, Your confessor, grant that, as he offered himself to You in sacrifice, so we may direct all the affections of our heart to You
S1026b.pc: May the Sacrament of Your Body and Blood, O Lord, which we have received, be the support of our frailty; that, imitating blessed Damian, Your confessor, we may run the way of Your commandments

S1030b.or: Pour into us, O Lord, the grace of penance, prayer and humility; that by imitating blessed Benvenuta, Your virgin, we may be able, mortifying the flesh, to live by the spirit, and, ever thinking on heavenly things and despising ourselves, to find rest and glory in You alone, our God
S1030b.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S1030b.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S1103b.or: O God, who, among his other virtues, adorned blessed Simon, Your confessor, with unceasing zeal for prayer and the singular privilege of humility; grant us to imitate him, that, despising all things of the world, we may seek You alone here, and at last be able to obtain the rewards promised in heaven to the humble
S1103b.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S1103b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Simon, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S1107b.or: O God, who mercifully granted to blessed Peter, Your servant, to be crowned with martyrdom for the defense of the true faith; grant by his merits and intercession that we may ever be able to please You by the faith that works through charity
S1107b.se: Offering You, O Lord, the sacrifice of praise and thanksgiving for the victory of blessed Peter, Your martyr, we humbly entreat Your boundless goodness that You would keep Your faithful people in holy religion, and call back to the unity of Your truth those scattered by heretical deceit
S1107b.pc: O God, who on that very day on which Your only-begotten Son, in the substance of our flesh, was presented in the temple by His immaculate Virgin Mother, received the soul of blessed Peter, Your martyr, into heaven; grant us through his intercession that, cleansed at the end of life by the divine mysteries, we may deserve to be presented in the temple of Your glory

S1114b.or: O God, who willed that blessed John, Your confessor, should shine forth by complete denial of self and by zeal for surpassing charity; grant us by imitating him that, renouncing earthly affections, we may live in Your love
S1114b.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S1114b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed John, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S1116b.or: O God, who caused blessed Lucy, wondrously adorned with the marks of Your Son's passion, by the gifts of virginity and patience to escape the flattering world and to overcome the persecuting world; grant that by her intercession and example we may neither be conquered by earthly allurements nor broken by any adversities
S1116b.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S1116b.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S1126b.or: O God, who granted to blessed James, Your confessor and bishop, faithfully to fulfil all the duties of a good shepherd; grant us through his intercession that, walking in the way of Your commandments, we may deserve to be placed for ever among the sheep of Your pasture
S1126b.se: We offer You, O Lord, the spotless victim, humbly entreating that, through the intercession of blessed James, cleansed from every stain, we may present ourselves to You as a pleasing victim
S1126b.pc: May blessed James, confessor and bishop, intercede for us, we beseech You, O Lord; and by his prayers grant that, nourished with heavenly food, we may reject all earthly things

S1216b.or: O God, who made blessed Sebastian, Your confessor, wonderful by his singular zeal for regular discipline and evangelical perfection; mercifully grant that by imitating him, mortified in the flesh and made alive in the spirit, we may obtain eternal rewards
S1216b.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S1216b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Sebastian, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

G566.or: O God, who willed that Your glorious Mother should be called Mary; grant, we beseech You, that those who call upon the sweet name of Mary may feel the unfailing help of her blessing
G566.se: Through Your mercy, O Lord, and the intercession of blessed Mary ever Virgin, may this offering avail us for prosperity and peace, both now and for ever
G566.pc: Having received, O Lord, the helps of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, that we may everywhere be protected by the patronage of blessed Mary ever Virgin, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

S0115.or: O God, who strengthened the faith of blessed Francis, Your martyr, with wonderful constancy; mercifully grant that Your Church, helped by his prayers, may deserve to celebrate new triumphs of the faith everywhere
S0115.se: O God, who by the works of true charity taught blessed Francis to prepare himself for offering this saving Victim; grant, we beseech You, that approaching the sacred mysteries with like ardor of charity, we may receive their fruit more abundantly
S0115.pc: O God, who willed that blessed Francis, while celebrating the sacred mysteries, should overflow with heavenly delights; grant us through his intercession that, refreshed with the bread of Angels, we may learn to despise the things of earth and bravely to overcome all adversities

S0122.or: Be present, O Lord, to our supplications, that we who know ourselves to be guilty by our iniquity may be delivered by the intercession of blessed Vincent, Your martyr
S0122.se: Having received our gifts and prayers, O Lord, we beseech You, through the intercession of blessed Vincent, Your martyr, both cleanse us by the heavenly mysteries and mercifully hear us
S0122.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Vincent, Your martyr, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0410b.or: O God, who made blessed Anthony, mercifully called back to the light of Your truth, an outstanding martyr; grant that through his intercession we may ever be steadfast in faith and effective in deed
S0410b.se: Having received our gifts and prayers, O Lord, we beseech You, through the intercession of blessed Anthony, Your martyr, both cleanse us by the heavenly mysteries and mercifully hear us
S0410b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Anthony, Your martyr, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0427b.or: Renew in our hearts, O Lord, the love of Your Cross, that by the intercession and example of blessed Osanna, Your penitent virgin, we may be made sharers in Your sufferings and in Your glory
S0427b.se: Receive, O Lord, these gifts which we offer in commemoration of blessed Osanna, Your virgin, and grant that through her intercession we may ever be able to please You by the gifts of chastity and penance
S0427b.pc: O God, who willed that we who partake of one bread and one chalice should be one body in Christ; through the intercession of blessed Osanna, Your virgin, confirm Your faithful in the truth, and call back to the unity of Your Church those who have strayed from the right faith

S1211.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable feast of blessed Damasus, Your confessor and bishop, may increase in us both devotion and salvation
S1211.se: May Your saints, we beseech You, O Lord, everywhere make us glad; that while we recall their merits we may feel their patronage
S1211.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that giving thanks for the gifts we have received, we may, through the intercession of blessed Damasus, Your confessor and bishop, receive still greater benefits

S0411.or: O God, who gave to Your people blessed Leo as a minister of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as an intercessor in heaven him whom we had on earth as a teacher of life
S0411.se: Almighty and eternal God, through the intercession of blessed Leo, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S0411.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may everywhere be helped by the prayer of blessed Leo, Your confessor and doctor, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

S0620b.or: Hear us, O God our Savior, that as we rejoice in the feast of blessed Osanna, Your virgin, so we may be taught the affection of loving devotion
S0620b.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S0620b.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S0805.or: Mercifully hear, O God, the supplication of Your servants, that we who are gathered together on the feast of the Mother of God and Virgin may by her intercession be delivered by You from the dangers that threaten us
S0805.se: May the humanity of Your only-begotten Son, O Lord, come to our aid; that He who, born of the Virgin, did not lessen but hallowed His Mother's integrity, may on her feast free us from our sins and make our offering acceptable to You, Jesus Christ our Lord
S0805.pc: We have received, O Lord, the votive sacraments of this yearly feast; grant, we beseech You, that they may bring us remedies for this temporal life and for the life eternal

S0531.or: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, that we who celebrate the feast of the blessed Virgin Mary, our Queen, may, defended by her protection, deserve to obtain peace in this life and glory in the life to come
S0531.se: Accept, we beseech You, O Lord, the gifts of Your rejoicing Church, and grant that, through the pleading merits of the blessed Virgin Mary, Queen, they may avail for the help of our salvation
S0531.pc: Having celebrated the solemnities which we have performed for the feast of holy Mary, our Queen, we beseech You, O Lord, that through her intercession they may become salutary for us, in whose honor they have been joyfully fulfilled

S0603.or: O God, who endowed Your blessed martyrs Peter, bishop, and his companions with equal firmness and charity for preaching the faith to the nations; grant, we beseech You, that by their example and intercession we may remain constant in Your faith
S0603.se: Graciously receive, O Lord, our prayers with the offerings of victims, and through the pleading of Your martyrs Peter, bishop, and his companions, kindly make them acceptable to Your loving kindness
S0603.pc: Almighty and merciful God, who kindle in the hearts of the saints the flame of Your love; grant us, through the sacraments we have received, the same faith and strength of charity, that we may profit by the example of those in whose triumphs we rejoice

S0727.or: May the blessed confession of Your martyrs Joseph, Melchior and their companions fortify us, O Lord, and graciously obtain help for our frailty
S0727.se: May Your blessing, O Lord, descend abundantly, to make our gifts acceptable to You through the prayers of Your holy martyrs, and to make them for us the sacrament of redemption
S0727.pc: Refreshed by the heavenly sacraments and joys, we humbly entreat You, O Lord, that we may be protected by the help of those in whose triumphs we glory

S0731.or: O God, who for the spreading of the greater glory of Your name strengthened the Church militant with a new help through blessed Ignatius; grant that, striving on earth by his help and example, we may deserve to be crowned with him in heaven
S0731.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0731.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Ignatius, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0815.or: May the venerable festival of this day, O Lord, bring us saving help, on which the holy Mother of God underwent temporal death, yet could not be held down by the bonds of death, she who brought forth of herself Your Son, our Lord, made flesh
S0815.se: May the prayer of the Mother of God, O Lord, come to the aid of Your people; that we who know that she has departed this life according to the condition of the flesh may feel that she intercedes for us with You in heavenly glory
S0815.pc: Made partakers of the heavenly table, we implore Your mercy, O Lord our God, that we who keep the Assumption of the Mother of God may by her intercession be delivered from all evils that threaten us

S0920.or: O God, who made blessed Francis, Your confessor, steeped in the sweetness of heavenly charity, an outstanding herald of Your word; grant through his intercession that, kindled with the fire of Your love, we may ever live in Your love
S0920.se: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that as blessed Francis, ever offering himself to You as a sacrifice, nourished his spirit for eternity, so he may ever win for us the abundance of Your grace
S0920.pc: Refreshed with sacred food, we humbly entreat You, almighty God, that through the intercession of blessed Francis, whom after offering You the sacrifice You caused to pass by a precious death to the haven of salvation, You would make us also, strengthened at the end of life with heavenly food, sharers of the same glory

S1207.or: O God, who gave to Your people blessed Ambrose as a minister of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have as an intercessor in heaven him whom we had on earth as a teacher of life
S1207.se: Almighty and eternal God, through the intercession of blessed Ambrose, Your confessor and bishop, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S1207.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, we beseech You, almighty God, that we may everywhere be helped by the prayer of blessed Ambrose, Your confessor and bishop, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

S0928b.or: O God, who made blessed Laurence, Your confessor, illustrious by zeal for regular discipline and by the ardor of charity; grant us through his intercession that, ever striving after what is more perfect, we may attain eternal joys
S0928b.se: Receive, O Lord, the offering which we make to You, and by the merits and imitation of blessed Laurence may we receive an increase of spiritual gifts
S0928b.pc: Refreshed, O Lord, with sacred gifts, we humbly entreat You that, despising the allurements of the world, we may, through the intercession of blessed Laurence, Your confessor, ever long for heavenly delights

S0222.or: O God, who, giving to blessed Peter, Your apostle, the keys of the heavenly kingdom, bestowed on him the high-priestly power of binding and loosing; grant that by the help of his intercession we may be delivered from the bonds of our sins
S0222.se: May the prayer of blessed Peter, Your apostle, we beseech You, O Lord, commend the prayers and offerings of Your Church, that what we celebrate for his glory may avail us for pardon
S0222.pc: May the gift offered, we beseech You, O Lord, gladden us, that as we proclaim You wonderful in Your apostle Peter, so through him we may receive the bounty of Your pardon

S0524.or: O God, who were pleased to enlighten Your Church by the merits and teaching of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father; grant that through his intercession she may not be deprived of temporal help, and may ever grow in spiritual increase
S0524.se: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts dedicated to You; that by the merits of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father, they may avail us for healing
S0524.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who are weighed down by the burden of our sins may be raised up by the patronage of blessed Dominic, Your confessor, our Father
