S0215.or: O God, who made blessed Henry, Your confessor, wonderful in the mortification of the body and in charity; grant that we may be able to express Christ crucified in our works and to love Him with our heart
S0215.se: O Lord Jesus Christ, who commanded that these sacred rites be done in remembrance of You; grant that, by imitating blessed Henry, we may think of You continually and savor You
S0215.pc: Refreshed at the table of divine wisdom, we beseech You, almighty God, that through the sacraments we have received, blessed Henry interceding, we may be nourished unto everlasting life

S0511.or: O God, who gladden us by the yearly feast of Your Apostles Philip and James; grant, we beseech You, that we may be taught by the example of those in whose merits we rejoice
S0511.se: Mercifully receive, O Lord, the gifts which we bring on the feast of Your Apostles Philip and James, and turn away from us all the evils we deserve
S0511.pc: Filled with the saving mysteries, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may be helped by the prayers of those whose feast we celebrate

S0225b.or: O God, who made blessed Constantius, Your confessor, glorious among the peoples by his zeal for constant prayer and for the furthering of peace; grant us by his intercession that, walking in the paths of justice, we may attain to everlasting peace and glory
S0225b.se: May it be granted us to sit at the table of the Lord in the wedding garment of charity, clothed in which blessed Constantius was found worthy to hear Jesus Christ our Lord inviting him to the higher place
S0225b.pc: Refreshed with the bread of Angels, we pray You, almighty God, that by the merits and intercession of blessed Constantius we may be able to render You eternal praise with him in heaven

S0303b.or: O God, who by the prayers and exhortations of blessed Peter, Your confessor, mercifully brought back the erring into the way of justice; enlarge our hearts, we beseech You, by his intercession, that we may ever run the way of Your commandments
S0303b.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0303b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S0419b.or: O God, who willed that blessed Albert, Your confessor, should shine with exceptional holiness in a humble state of life; make us so to follow in his footsteps that we may deserve to attain also his reward
S0419b.se: We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in commemoration of Your saints, through whom we trust to be delivered from evils both present and to come
S0419b.pc: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of him in whose commemoration we have received these gifts

S0503b.or: O God, who granted to blessed Emily, Your virgin, to despise all earthly things and to seek You alone; grant by her merits and intercession that, spurning perishable allurements, we may love You with our whole heart
S0503b.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S0503b.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S1010b.or: Stir up, O Lord, in our hearts the love of the cross and passion, that through the intercession and example of blessed Matthew we may be made partakers of the sufferings of Christ and of His glory
S1010b.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S1010b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Matthew, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

S1012b.or: O God, who in blessed Dominic, Your confessor, wonderfully made fruitful his apostolic office through constant zeal for prayer and the observance of regular discipline; mercifully grant that, following in his footsteps, we may deserve to gather abundant fruits of salvation
S1012b.se: Receive, O God, this spotless Victim, and, Your servant Dominic pleading for us, grant, we beseech You, that offering ourselves with chaste body and devout mind, we may fulfil with worthy service the offering of Your Son our Lord Jesus Christ
S1012b.pc: May Your sanctifying grace, we beseech You, O Lord, make us docile, that by the intercession of blessed Dominic, walking earnestly before You, we may ever grow in Your love

S1127b.or: O God, who taught blessed Margaret to pass with her whole heart from the pomp of the world to the humble following of Your cross; grant that by her merits and example we may learn to tread underfoot the perishing delights of the world and, in the embrace of Your cross, to overcome all that opposes us
S1127b.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that they may become pleasing to You and salutary to us through the devout supplication of blessed Margaret
S1127b.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that those whom You have deigned to instruct by the saving mysteries You may refresh with heavenly food through the glorious intercession of blessed Margaret

S0819b.or: O God, who made blessed Jordan, Your confessor, a worthy minister of the preaching of the Gospel; grant us by his example to do what You command, that we may be able to obtain the fruit of eternal reward
S0819b.se: Through this spotless Victim may the intercession of blessed Jordan be pleasing for us, that, freed from all dangers in time, we may deserve to be partakers of the glory of eternity
S0819b.pc: Having received the sacred gifts, we implore Your mercy, O Lord, that through the intercession of blessed Jordan, Your confessor, we may so pass through the prosperity and adversity of this present life that we may attain everlasting glory

S1007.or: O God, whose only-begotten Son, by His life, death, and resurrection, has purchased for us the rewards of eternal salvation; grant, we beseech You, that, meditating upon these mysteries in the most holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary, we may both imitate what they contain and obtain what they promise
S1007.se: Make us, we beseech You, O Lord, fitly prepared to offer these gifts, and through the mysteries of the most holy Rosary so to recall the life, passion, and glory of Your only-begotten Son that we may be made worthy of His promises
S1007.pc: May we be helped, we beseech You, O Lord, by the prayers of Your most holy Mother, whose Rosary we celebrate, that we may receive the power of the mysteries which we honor and obtain the effect of the sacraments which we have received

S0504.or: O God, the consoler of the sorrowful and the salvation of those who hope in You, who mercifully accepted the loving tears of blessed Monica for the conversion of her son Augustine; grant us, through the intercession of them both, to bewail our sins and to find the pardon of Your grace
S0504.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S0504.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S0703.or: O God, who granted to blessed Irenaeus, Your martyr and bishop, both to overcome heresies by the truth of his teaching and happily to establish peace in the Church; give, we beseech You, to Your people constancy in holy religion, and grant Your peace in our times
S0703.se: O God, who do not let the peoples who believe in You be shaken by any terrors, deign to receive the prayers and offerings of the people dedicated to You, that the peace granted by Your goodness may make the borders of Christians safe from every enemy
S0703.pc: O God, the author and lover of peace, to know whom is to live, to serve whom is to reign, protect Your suppliants from all assaults, that we who trust in Your defence may, through the intercession of blessed Irenaeus, Your martyr and bishop, fear the arms of no enemy

S0729.or: Hear us, O God our Saviour, that as we rejoice in the feast of blessed Martha, Your virgin, so we may be taught the spirit of loving devotion
S0729.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S0729.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S0812.or: We beseech You, O Lord, that Your servants who keep the feast of the birthday of blessed Clare, Your virgin, may by her intercession be made partakers of heavenly joys and co-heirs of Your only-begotten Son
S0812.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S0812.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S1202.or: May blessed Bibiana, virgin and martyr, we beseech You, O Lord, implore pardon for us, she who was ever pleasing to You both by the merit of her chastity and by the confession of Your power
S1202.se: Receive, O Lord, the gifts we bring on the feast of blessed Bibiana, Your virgin and martyr, by whose patronage we trust to be delivered
S1202.pc: May the mysteries we have received help us, O Lord, and, through the intercession of blessed Bibiana, Your virgin and martyr, strengthen us with everlasting protection

S0508.or: O Lord Jesus Christ, our mediator with the Father, who have deigned to appoint the most blessed Virgin, Your Mother, to be our mother also and our mediatrix with You; mercifully grant that whoever comes to You seeking favors may rejoice to have obtained them all through her
S0508.se: By the prayers of Your Mother and our Mediatrix, we beseech You, O Lord, may the offering of this sacrifice, by the gift of Your grace, make of ourselves an everlasting offering to You
S0508.pc: May the prayer of blessed Mary, Your Mother and our Mediatrix, help us, O Lord, that through these most holy mysteries, by the gift of Your grace, we may advance towards the increase of eternal redemption

S0910.or: O God, who gladden us by the triumph of the blessed Alphonsus and his companions; grant us, we beseech You, by their merits and intercession, the same constancy in faith and fruitfulness in work
S0910.se: We offer You sacrifices, O Lord, on the feast of Your blessed ones, humbly beseeching You that, as their passion made them glorious, so our devotion may make us acceptable
S0910.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who keep the memory of Your blessed martyrs may also imitate their faith and fortitude, and, having overcome the attacks of our enemies, may rejoice in the confession of Your eternal name

S0111b.or: O God, who called blessed Bernard back from the vices of the world and led him into the way of perfection; grant by his merits and prayers that we, bewailing our sins, may turn to You with pure minds
S0111b.se: Receive, we beseech You, O Lord, the gift we offer, and mercifully grant that, following the example of blessed Bernard, we may be steadfastly fervent in Your love to the end
S0111b.pc: Fed with the delights of the heavenly banquet, we humbly pray You, O Lord, that through the intercession of blessed Bernard, whose memory we keep today, we may deserve to be filled with the abundance of saving gifts

Quad3h.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the holy devotion of our fasts may both bring us purification and make us acceptable to Your majesty
Quad3h.se: May this offering, we beseech You, O Lord, be made pleasing to You by our solemn fasts, and, that it may be the more acceptable to You, may it be offered with purified minds
Quad3h.pc: May the reverent reception of Your sacrament, O Lord, both cleanse us by its mystic working and defend us by its everlasting power

Pasc6s.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the splendor of Your brightness may shine upon us, and that the light of Your light may, by the enlightening of the Holy Spirit, strengthen the hearts of those who have been born again by Your grace
Pasc6s.se: Sanctify, we beseech You, O Lord, the gifts offered, and cleanse our hearts by the enlightening of the Holy Spirit
Pasc6s.pc: May the outpouring of the Holy Spirit cleanse our hearts, O Lord, and make them fruitful by the inward sprinkling of His dew

S0113.or: O God, whose only-begotten Son has appeared in the substance of our flesh, grant, we beseech You, that through Him whom we have known outwardly like unto ourselves we may deserve to be inwardly renewed
S0113.se: We bring You offerings, O Lord, for the manifestation of Your Son who was born, humbly beseeching You that, as He is Himself the author of our gifts, so He may also be their merciful receiver, Jesus Christ our Lord
S0113.pc: Go before us, we beseech You, O Lord, always and everywhere with heavenly light, that we may discern with clear sight and receive with worthy love the mystery in which You have willed us to share

S0814.or: O God, who deigned to choose the virginal dwelling of blessed Mary in which to dwell, grant, we beseech You, that, defended by her protection, You may make us take part with joy in her feast
S0814.se: May the prayer of the Mother of God commend our gifts to Your mercy, O Lord, for You took her from this present world that she might intercede confidently with You for our sins
S0814.pc: Grant, O merciful God, a safeguard to our frailty, that we who keep the eve of the feast of the holy Mother of God may by the help of her intercession rise again from our iniquities

C64s.or: O God, who for the glory of Your majesty and the salvation of mankind appointed Your only-begotten Son the supreme and eternal Priest, grant that those whom He has chosen to be ministers and dispensers of His mysteries may be found faithful in fulfilling the ministry they have received
C64s.se: May our mediator Jesus Christ, O Lord, make these gifts acceptable to You, and present us, together with Himself, as victims pleasing to You
C64s.pc: May the divine Victim which we have offered and received give us life, we beseech You, O Lord, that, joined to You in everlasting love, we may bring forth fruit that will last for ever

C68s.or: Almighty and everlasting God, who in Your mercy accepted the passion of Your Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, as the price of man's redemption, mercifully grant that, as we keep today the memory of the pains and sorrows of His passion, so we may deserve to share in their fruits
C68s.se: Almighty and everlasting God, who restore us by the blessed passion of Christ Your Son, preserve in us the works of Your mercy, that in the celebration of this mystery we may live in unceasing devotion
C68s.pc: Refreshed with life-giving food, almighty God, we humbly entreat You that, as we celebrate with devout affection the pains and sorrows which Your Son our Lord endured in His passion, so You may ever protect us with Your kindly help and preserve us from all evil by Your unfailing goodness

C85s.or: O God, who correct what has gone astray, gather what is scattered, and keep what is gathered, mercifully pour out, we beseech You, upon the Christian people the grace of Your unity, that, putting away division and uniting themselves to the true Shepherd of Your Church, they may be able to serve You worthily
C85s.se: Sanctify, O Lord, these gifts offered to You for the unity of the Christian people, and through them grant us the gifts of unity and peace in Your Church
C85s.pc: May this holy communion of Yours which we have received, O Lord, as it foreshadows the union of the faithful in You, so work, we beseech You, the effect of unity in Your Church

C89s.or: With humble supplication, O Lord, we pray that Your boundless goodness may grant to the most holy Roman Church a Pontiff who, by his devoted care for us, may be ever pleasing to You, and by his wholesome government may be held in honor by Your people for the glory of Your name
C89s.se: May the abundance of Your goodness, O Lord, grant us that, through the sacred gifts which we reverently offer You, we may rejoice that a Pontiff pleasing to Your majesty presides over the government of holy Mother Church
C89s.pc: Refreshed by the sacrament of Your precious Body and Blood, O Lord, may the wonderful grace of Your majesty gladden us by the gift of that supreme Pontiff who will instruct Your people in virtue and fill the minds of the faithful with the fragrance of spiritual perfumes

C104s.or: O God, who desire not the death but the repentance of sinners, mercifully turn Your people to Yourself, we beseech You, that, while they are devoted to You, You may remove from them the scourges of Your anger
C104s.se: May the offering of this present sacrifice help us, we beseech You, O Lord, mightily absolving us from all errors and rescuing us from the onset of all destruction
C104s.pc: Hear us, O God our Saviour, and, blessed Mary ever Virgin interceding with all the Saints, free Your people from the terrors of Your anger and make them secure in the bounty of Your mercy

C110s.or: O God, who consecrated the union of marriage by so excellent a mystery as to foreshadow in the marriage covenant the sacrament of Christ and the Church, grant, we beseech You, that what is administered by our office may rather be fulfilled by Your blessing
C110s.se: Receive, we beseech You, O Lord, the gift offered for the sacred law of marriage, and, as You are the giver of the gift, be also the disposer of the work
C110s.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, accompany with Your gracious favor what Your providence has instituted, and keep in long-lasting love those whom You join in lawful union

C114s.or: O God, whose property is ever to have mercy and to spare, we humbly entreat You for the soul of Your servant N., which You have this day called out of this world, that You would not deliver it into the hands of the enemy, nor forget it for ever, but command it to be received by the holy Angels and led to the home of paradise, that, since it hoped and believed in You, it may not undergo the pains of hell, but may possess everlasting joys
C114s.se: Be merciful, we beseech You, O Lord, to the soul of Your servant N., for which we offer You the sacrifice of praise, humbly entreating Your majesty that through these offices of loving propitiation it may deserve to come to everlasting rest
C114s.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the soul of Your servant N., which has this day departed out of this world, being cleansed by this sacrifice and freed from sins, may receive both pardon and everlasting rest

S1113.or: O God, the Lord of mercies, grant to the souls of Your servants and handmaids, the anniversary of whose burial we commemorate, a place of refreshment, the happiness of rest and the brightness of light
S1113.se: Be appeased, O Lord, by our supplications for the souls of Your servants and handmaids whose anniversary is kept today, for whom we offer You the sacrifice of praise, that You may deign to join them to the fellowship of Your Saints
S1113.pc: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that the souls of Your servants and handmaids, the anniversary of whose burial we commemorate, being cleansed by this sacrifice, may obtain both pardon and everlasting rest

G420.or: O God, who by the Immaculate Conception of the Virgin prepared a worthy dwelling for Your Son, we humbly beseech You that, celebrating the Apparition of the same Virgin, we may obtain health of mind and body
G420.se: May the sacrifice of praise which we offer You, O Lord, through the merits of the glorious and Immaculate Virgin, be to You an odor of sweetness, and bring us the health of body and soul we desire
G420.pc: May the right hand of Your Immaculate Mother, O Lord, uphold those whom You have fed with heavenly food, that by her help we may deserve to reach our eternal home

G505.or: O God, who taught the multitude of the Gentiles by the preaching of blessed Paul the Apostle, grant us, we beseech You, that we who keep his birthday may feel the help of his patronage with You
G505.se: May the prayer of the Apostles accompany the offerings which we bring to be consecrated to Your name, O Lord, and by it grant us to be cleansed and defended
G505.pc: Having received Your sacraments, O Lord, we pray that, by the intercession of blessed Paul Your Apostle, what has been celebrated for his glory may avail for our healing

S0211.or: O God, who by the Immaculate Conception of the Virgin prepared a worthy dwelling for Your Son, we humbly beseech You that, celebrating the Apparition of the same Virgin, we may obtain health of mind and body
S0211.se: May the sacrifice of praise which we offer You, O Lord, through the merits of the glorious and Immaculate Virgin, be to You an odor of sweetness, and bring us the health of body and soul we desire
S0211.pc: May the right hand of Your Immaculate Mother, O Lord, uphold those whom You have fed with heavenly food, that by her help we may deserve to reach our eternal home

S0630.or: O God, who taught the multitude of the Gentiles by the preaching of blessed Paul the Apostle, grant us, we beseech You, that we who keep his birthday may feel the help of his patronage with You
S0630.se: May the prayer of the Apostles accompany the offerings which we bring to be consecrated to Your name, O Lord, and by it grant us to be cleansed and defended
S0630.pc: Having received Your sacraments, O Lord, we pray that, by the intercession of blessed Paul Your Apostle, what has been celebrated for his glory may avail for our healing

Dec25_2.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who are bathed in the new light of Your Word made flesh may show forth in our actions that which by faith shines in our minds
Dec25_2.se: May our gifts, we beseech You, O Lord, be fitting for the mysteries of this day's Nativity and ever pour peace into us, that, as He who was born a man shone forth also as God, so this earthly substance may bestow on us what is divine
Dec25_2.pc: May the ever-new birth of this sacrament renew us, O Lord, since His singular birth has driven out our old humanity

Nat2.or: O God, who appointed Your only-begotten Son to be the Saviour of mankind and commanded that He be called Jesus, mercifully grant that we who venerate His holy Name on earth may also enjoy the sight of Him in heaven
Nat2.se: In veneration of the Name of Your most beloved Son our Lord, O Father of mercies, we offer these sacrifices with devout minds, humbly beseeching You to make our hearts rich with the sweetness of His Name and to let them delight in nothing but You, the true God
Nat2.pc: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that the holy mysteries which we have received in honor of the most lovable Name of Your Son our Lord Jesus Christ may inflame our affection to love this saving Name of Jesus, and happily move us to rejoice in God our Saviour

5as.or: Hearken, O Lord, to our supplications, and grant that we may keep with devout service this solemn fast, which was wholesomely instituted for the healing of souls and bodies
5as.se: Prepare us, we beseech You, O Lord, by the festal offices of this abstinence, that we may ever celebrate these venerable sacrifices with sober minds
5as.pc: Quickened by the gift of the heavenly life, we beseech You, O Lord, that what is for us a mystery in this present life may become our help for eternity

Dedicatio.or: O God, who year by year renew for us the day of the consecration of this Your holy temple, and bring us again in safety to Your sacred mysteries, hear the prayers of Your people, and grant that whoever enters this temple to ask for blessings may rejoice to have obtained them all
Dedicatio.se: Hearken, we beseech You, O Lord, to our prayers, that all of us who are gathered within the walls of this temple, the anniversary of whose dedication we celebrate, may please You with full and perfect devotion of body and soul, so that, while we render these present offerings, we may by Your help deserve to attain to eternal rewards
Dedicatio.pc: O God, who deigned to call Your Church Your bride, that she who had grace through the devotion of faith might also have holiness from the name; grant that all this people serving Your name may deserve to be worthy of sharing that title, and that Your Church, gathered to You in the temple whose anniversary of dedication is kept, may fear You, love You and follow You, that, walking ever in Your footsteps, she may under Your guidance deserve to come to the heavenly promises

S1109.or: O God, who year by year renew for us the day of the consecration of this Your holy temple, and bring us again in safety to Your sacred mysteries, hear the prayers of Your people, and grant that whoever enters this temple to ask for blessings may rejoice to have obtained them all
S1109.se: Hearken, we beseech You, O Lord, to our prayers, that all of us who are gathered within the walls of this temple, the anniversary of whose dedication we celebrate, may please You with full and perfect devotion of body and soul, so that, while we render these present offerings, we may by Your help deserve to attain to eternal rewards
S1109.pc: O God, who deigned to call Your Church Your bride, that she who had grace through the devotion of faith might also have holiness from the name; grant that all this people serving Your name may deserve to be worthy of sharing that title, and that Your Church, gathered to You in the temple whose anniversary of dedication is kept, may fear You, love You and follow You, that, walking ever in Your footsteps, she may under Your guidance deserve to come to the heavenly promises

S1118.or: O God, who year by year renew for us the day of the consecration of this Your holy temple, and bring us again in safety to Your sacred mysteries, hear the prayers of Your people, and grant that whoever enters this temple to ask for blessings may rejoice to have obtained them all
S1118.se: Hearken, we beseech You, O Lord, to our prayers, that all of us who are gathered within the walls of this temple, the anniversary of whose dedication we celebrate, may please You with full and perfect devotion of body and soul, so that, while we render these present offerings, we may by Your help deserve to attain to eternal rewards
S1118.pc: O God, who deigned to call Your Church Your bride, that she who had grace through the devotion of faith might also have holiness from the name; grant that all this people serving Your name may deserve to be worthy of sharing that title, and that Your Church, gathered to You in the temple whose anniversary of dedication is kept, may fear You, love You and follow You, that, walking ever in Your footsteps, she may under Your guidance deserve to come to the heavenly promises

S0120.or: O God, who strengthened Your blessed martyrs Fabian and Sebastian with the power of constancy in their passion, grant us by their example, for love of You, to despise the prosperity of the world and to fear none of its adversities
S0120.se: May the offering of our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, and may it become saving for us through the supplication of those on whose feast it is offered
S0120.pc: Filled with the sacred gift, we humbly pray You, O Lord, that what we celebrate in the office of the service we owe, we may, by the intercession of Your blessed martyrs Fabian and Sebastian, feel as an increase of Your salvation

S0224.or: O God, who joined blessed Matthias to the company of Your Apostles, grant, we beseech You, that by his intercession we may ever feel the tenderness of Your love towards us
S0224.se: O God, who by the election of blessed Matthias made good the fall of the apostate traitor, so that the sacred number of Your Apostles should not lack its completeness, sanctify these present gifts, that by them we may be strengthened through the power of Your grace
S0224.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty and merciful God, that through these holy things which we have received, by the intercession of blessed Matthias Your Apostle, we may obtain pardon and peace

S0319.or: May we be helped, we beseech You, O Lord, by the merits of the blessed Patriarch Joseph, the spouse of Your most holy Mother, that what our own power cannot obtain may be given us by his intercession
S0319.se: We render You, O Lord, the debt of our service, humbly beseeching You that by the prayers of blessed Joseph, spouse of the Mother of Your Son Jesus Christ our Lord, You may guard Your gifts in us, on whose venerable feast we offer You sacrifices of praise
S0319.pc: May the feast of the most blessed Patriarch Joseph, we beseech You, O Lord, be to us through these holy things which we have received a saving protection, he who was found worthy to adore in the manger the Son of his precious spouse the Virgin Mother, our Lord Jesus Christ Your Son; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end

S0324.or: Almighty and everlasting God, whom thousands of Angels serve, grant, we beseech You, that we who venerate on earth blessed Gabriel the Archangel, the chief minister of man's restoration, may by his prayers obtain in heaven the fruit of our redemption
S0324.se: May the gift of our service be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, together with the prayer of blessed Gabriel the Archangel, that he who is venerated by us on earth may be our advocate with You in heaven
S0324.pc: Having received the mysteries of Your Body and Blood, we entreat Your mercy, O Lord our God, that, as by the message of Gabriel we have known Your incarnation, so by his help we may obtain the benefits of that same incarnation

S0425.or: O God, who exalted blessed Mark, Your Evangelist, by the grace of preaching the Gospel, grant, we beseech You, that we may ever profit by his teaching and be defended by his prayer
S0425.se: Bringing You gifts on the feast of blessed Mark, Your Evangelist, we beseech You, O Lord, that, as the preaching of the Gospel made him glorious, so his intercession may make us acceptable to You in word and deed
S0425.pc: Fed with the food of spiritual nourishment, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that what we often receive in mystery we may, by the intercession of blessed Mark the Evangelist, obtain in the fullness of truth

S0824.or: Almighty and everlasting God, who have given us the holy and venerable joy of this day in the feast of blessed Bartholomew Your Apostle, grant to Your Church, we beseech You, both to love what he believed and to preach what he taught
S0824.se: Keeping the feast of blessed Bartholomew Your Apostle, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may receive Your benefits by his help, for whom we offer You sacrifices of praise
S0824.pc: We have received, O Lord, the pledge of eternal salvation, celebrating the feast of blessed Bartholomew Your Apostle, that, venerating his everlasting merits, we may be nourished unto eternal life

S0825.or: O God, who brought blessed Louis, Your confessor, from an earthly kingdom to the glory of the heavenly kingdom, make us, we beseech You, by his merits and intercession, to share the kingdom of the King of kings, Jesus Christ Your Son
S0825.se: Sanctify, we beseech You, O Lord, the gifts offered, that by the intercession of blessed Louis Your confessor they may prepare for us a dwelling in the heavenly kingdom
S0825.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the glorious intercession of blessed Louis, Your king and confessor, may make co-heirs of the heavenly kingdom those whom the misery of sin has made exiles here

S0914.or: O God, who gladden us today by the yearly feast of the Exaltation of the holy Cross, grant, we beseech You, that we who have known its mystery on earth may obtain the rewards of its redemption in heaven
S0914.se: May this offering, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse us from all our sins, this offering which on the altar of the Cross took away the sin of the whole world
S0914.pc: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, we beseech You, almighty God, to defend from the fear of their enemies those whom You have redeemed by the precious Blood of Your Son our Lord Jesus Christ

S1004.or: O God, who by the merits of our blessed Father Francis enlarge Your Church with the increase of a new offspring, grant us by his example to despise earthly things and ever to rejoice in sharing heavenly gifts
S1004.se: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts dedicated to You, and by the intercession of our blessed Father Francis cleanse us from every stain of sin
S1004.pc: May heavenly grace, we beseech You, O Lord, increase Your Church, which You have willed to enlighten by the glorious merits and example of our blessed Father Francis, Your confessor

S1024.or: O God, who gave blessed Raphael the Archangel to Your servant Tobias as a companion on his journey, grant to us Your servants that we may ever be protected by his care and defended by his help
S1024.se: We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise, humbly entreating You that, the prayers of the Angels interceding for us, You may graciously accept them and grant that they may avail for our salvation
S1024.pc: Filled, O Lord, with heavenly blessing, we humbly implore You that what we celebrate in our frail service we may feel to profit us by the help of the holy Angels and Archangels

G470.or: O God, who deigned to choose blessed Pius as supreme Pontiff to crush the enemies of Your Church and to restore divine worship, make us to be defended by his protection and so to cleave to Your service that, overcoming the snares of all our enemies, we may rejoice in everlasting peace
G470.se: Receive, we beseech You, O Lord, the prayers and offerings of Your Church, that by the intercession of blessed Pius, Your confessor and bishop, they may rise in Your sight as an odor of sweetness
G470.pc: Graciously pour out, O Lord God, the spirit of justice and fortitude on Your faithful, whom You have deigned to protect from the onslaught of all their enemies by the zeal and constancy of blessed Pius, Your confessor and bishop

G481.or: O God, who exalted blessed Philip, Your confessor, to the glory of Your Saints, mercifully grant that we who rejoice in his feast may profit by the example of his virtues
G481.se: Look graciously, we beseech You, O Lord, upon this present sacrifice, and grant that the Holy Spirit may inflame us with that fire with which He wonderfully pierced the heart of blessed Philip
G481.pc: Fed with heavenly delights, we beseech You, O Lord, that by the merits and example of blessed Philip, Your confessor, we may ever long for those things by which we truly live

G475.or: O Lord Jesus Christ, who took up into heaven the blessed virgin Imelda, wounded with the burning love of charity and wonderfully refreshed with the spotless Host, grant us by her intercession to approach the holy Table with the same fervor of charity, that we may long to be dissolved and deserve to be with You
G475.se: Receive, O Lord, the gifts which we offer You, and, by the merits and intercession of blessed Imelda, virgin, pour into us the spirit of Your love, that, despising earthly affections, our hearts may be fixed on You, where true joys are
G475.pc: May blessed Imelda, virgin, be for us, O Lord, an unfailing pleader before the throne of Your mercy, that, as she, having received the saving Host, flew to eternal glory, so the sharing of so great a mystery may be for us in life the cleansing of our sins, and in death the way by which we may come to life eternal

S0428.or: O Lord Jesus Christ, who endowed saint Paul with singular charity to preach the mystery of the Cross, and willed that through him a new family should flourish in the Church, grant us by his intercession that, ever recalling Your passion on earth, we may deserve to obtain its fruit in heaven
S0428.se: May these mysteries, O Lord, give us that fervor for Your passion and death with which saint Paul, in offering them, presented his body to You as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to You
S0428.pc: We have received, O Lord, the divine sacrament, the everlasting memorial of Your boundless charity; grant, we beseech You, that by the merits and example of saint Paul we may draw from Your fountains water springing up into life eternal, and may hold fast in our conduct and life Your most sacred passion impressed upon our hearts

C15s.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who keep the feast of blessed N., Your martyr and bishop, may be helped by his intercession with You
C15s.se: May this sacrifice, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse us from our sins, and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the celebration of the sacrifice
C15s.pc: Refreshed by partaking of the sacred gift, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that, by the intercession of blessed N., Your martyr and bishop, we may feel the effect of the rite we perform

C25s.or: O God, who grant us to keep the birthday of Your holy martyrs N. and N., grant us to rejoice in their company in everlasting bliss
C25s.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that they may be pleasing to You for the honor of Your saints and, by Your mercy, become salutary to us
C25s.pc: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, by the intercession of Your holy martyrs N. and N., that what we have touched with our lips we may receive with a pure mind

C28s.or: O God, who grant us to keep the birthday of Your holy martyrs N. and N., grant us to rejoice in their company in everlasting bliss
C28s.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that they may be pleasing to You for the honor of Your saints and, by Your mercy, become salutary to us
C28s.pc: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, by the intercession of Your holy martyrs N. and N., that what we have touched with our lips we may receive with a pure mind

C55s.or: Hear us, O God our Saviour, that as we rejoice in the feast of blessed N., Your virgin, so we may be taught the spirit of loving devotion
C55s.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
C55s.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S0117.or: May the intercession of blessed Anthony the Abbot, we beseech You, O Lord, commend us to You, that what we cannot obtain by our own merits we may obtain by his patronage
S0117.se: May saint Anthony the Abbot, we beseech You, O Lord, ask that the sacrifices laid upon Your holy altars may avail for our salvation
S0117.pc: May blessed Anthony the Abbot, interceding for us, protect us, O Lord, together with the reception of Your sacrament, that we may both experience the excellence of his way of life and receive the help of his intercession

S0127.or: May heavenly grace, we beseech You, O Lord, increase Your Church, which You have willed to enlighten by the glorious merits and teaching of blessed John Chrysostom, Your confessor and bishop
S0127.se: Recalling the memory of the Passion of Your Son, O Lord, we ask that the sacrifice which we offer You on the feast of blessed John Chrysostom, Your bishop, may be acceptable
S0127.pc: May this holy communion, we beseech You, O Lord, gladden us, that by the prayers of blessed John Chrysostom, Your bishop, our virtues may be strengthened within and the works of devout service may increase without

S0128.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0128.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity
S0128.or: O God, You Who, as an example of Your love, divinely taught St. Peter to enrich Your Church with new offspring, a family of Religious devoted to the ransom of the faithful, grant by his intercession, that we may be released from the slavery of sin and rejoice in lasting freedom in heaven.

S0129.se: Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Francis, Your bishop and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S0129.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Francis, Your bishop and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty
S0129.or: O God, Who for the salvation of souls willed that blessed Francis, Your Confessor and Bishop, should become all things to all men, mercifully grant that we, inspired by the sweetness of Your love, guided by his teachings, and aided by his merits, may attain the joys of everlasting life.

S0131.or: O God, Who in Your Confessor, blessed John, raised up a father and teacher of youth, and willed that through him, with the help of the Virgin Mary, new religious families should bloom in the Church, grant, we beseech You, that, inflamed by the same fire of love, we may seek to win souls and to serve You alone.
S0131.se: Accept, O Lord, this pure offering of the saving Host, and grant, that loving You in all and above all, we may be found worthy to live for the praise of Your glory.
S0131.pc: Nourished with the mystery of Your Body and Blood, grant, we beseech You, O Lord, through the intercession of Saint John, Your Confessor, that we may continue to be thankful.

S0202.or: Almighty, eternal God, we humbly beseech Your majesty that, as Your only-begotten Son was this day presented in the temple in the nature of our flesh, so may You grant us to be presented to You with purified minds.
S0202.se: O Lord, heed our prayer, and give us the help of Your loving kindness so that the gifts we offer before the eyes of Your majesty may be worthy of You.
S0202.pc: We beseech You, O Lord our God, that the sacrament You have given as the bulwark of our atonement may be made a saving remedy for us in this life and in the life to come.

S0204.se: May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, and may it become saving for us through the supplication of him on whose feast it is offered
S0204.pc: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, to Your faithful ever to rejoice in the veneration of Your saints and to be defended by their unceasing intercession
S0204.or: O God, Who establish ever new examples of virtue in Your Church, grant that Your people may follow the footsteps of blessed Andrew, Your Confessor and Bishop, so that they may also obtain his reward.

S0208.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0208.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed John, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity
S0208.or: O God, Who graciously and by divine means founded through blessed John, the Order of the Most Holy Trinity to ransom captives from the hands of the Saracens, grant, we beseech You, that through Your help and the merits of his prayers we may be freed body and soul from captivity.

S0209.or: O God, Who made Cyril, Your Confessor and Bishop, an unconquerable champion of the most Blessed Virgin Mary’s divine motherhood, grant that we who believe that she is truly the Mother of God may be saved by her motherly protection.
S0209.se: Look graciously, almighty God, upon our gifts and, through the intercession of blessed Cyril, grant that we may receive worthily into our hearts, Your only-begotten Son, Jesus Christ, our Lord, Who is with You co-eternal in Your glory.
S0209.pc: Strengthened by the Blessed Sacrament, we humbly beseech You, O Lord, that, helped by the example and merits of the blessed Bishop Cyril, we may be worthy servants of the most holy Mother of Your only-begotten Son.

S0223.se: Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S0223.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Peter, Your confessor and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty
S0223.or: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, to follow the counsel and examples of St. Peter, Your Confessor and Bishop, so that by setting earthly goods at naught we may attain everlasting happiness.

S0404.or: O God, who gave blessed Isidore to Your people as a minister of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven whom we had as the teacher of life on earth
S0404.se: Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Isidore, Your bishop and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S0404.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Isidore, Your bishop and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

S0421.or: O God, who gave blessed Anselm to Your people as a minister of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven whom we had as the teacher of life on earth
S0421.se: Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Anselm, Your bishop and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S0421.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Anselm, Your bishop and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

S0114.or: O God, who gave blessed Hilary to Your people as a minister of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven whom we had as the teacher of life on earth
S0114.se: Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Hilary, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S0114.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Hilary, Your confessor and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

S0502.or: O God, who gave blessed Athanasius to Your people as a minister of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven whom we had as the teacher of life on earth
S0502.se: Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Athanasius, Your confessor and bishop, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S0502.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Athanasius, Your confessor and bishop, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

S0510.or: May we be helped, O Lord, by the merits of saint Antoninus, Your confessor and bishop, that, as we proclaim You wonderful in him, so we may glory that You have been merciful to us
S0510.se: May blessed Antoninus the priest, O Lord, make our sacrifice acceptable in the eyes of Your majesty, he who while he lived offered himself to You as a holy and pleasing victim
S0510.pc: Refreshed with life-giving food, we give You thanks, O Lord, and ask that what we have received for the glory of Your holy bishop Antoninus may by his prayers be our help against the assaults of the enemy

S0527.se: Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Bede, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S0527.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Bede, Your confessor and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty
S0527.or: O God, Who enlightened Your Church with the learning of blessed Bede, Your Confessor and Doctor, graciously grant that Your servants may ever be enlightened by his wisdom and helped by his merits.

S0606.se: May Your saints, we beseech You, O Lord, everywhere gladden us, that while we recall their merits we may feel their protection
S0606.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that, giving thanks for the gifts received, we may, by the intercession of blessed Norbert, Your confessor and bishop, receive still greater benefits
S0606.or: O God, Who made blessed Norbert, Your Confessor and Bishop, a brilliant preacher of Your word, and through him enriched Your Church with a new religious family, grant, we beseech You, that by his prayerful intercession and Your help, we may be able to do what he has taught us by his words and deeds.

S0611.or: We beseech You, almighty God, that blessed Barnabas the Apostle may implore Your help for us, that, being freed from our sins, we may also be delivered from all dangers
S0611.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gift to be consecrated, by which, keeping the feast of blessed Barnabas Your Apostle, we implore also the cleansing of our minds
S0611.pc: Having received the sacraments, O Lord, we humbly entreat You that, by the intercession of blessed Barnabas Your Apostle, what we do in veneration of his passion may avail for our healing

S0613.or: May the devout feast of blessed Anthony, Your confessor, gladden Your Church, O God, that she may ever be defended by spiritual help and deserve to enjoy everlasting joys
S0613.se: May this present offering, O Lord, be saving for Your people, for whom You deigned to offer Yourself to Your Father as a living victim; who with the same God the Father and the Holy Spirit live and reign, God, world without end
S0613.pc: Filled with divine gifts, we beseech You, O Lord, that by the glorious merits of blessed Anthony, Your confessor, we may feel the longed-for effect of the saving Victim

S0618.se: Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Ephrem, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S0618.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Ephrem, Your confessor and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty
S0618.or: O God, Who willed to enlighten Your Church by the wondrous learning and glorious merits of the life of blessed Ephrem, Your Confessor and Doctor, we humbly pray You, that, by his pleading, You will shield her with Your lasting power against the snares of error and evil.

S0712.or: May the intercession of blessed John the Abbot, we beseech You, O Lord, commend us to You, that what we cannot obtain by our own merits we may obtain by his patronage
S0712.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S0712.pc: May blessed John the Abbot, interceding for us, protect us, O Lord, together with the reception of Your sacrament, that we may both experience the excellence of his way of life and receive the help of his intercession

S0714.or: O God, who gave blessed Bonaventure to Your people as a minister of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven whom we had as the teacher of life on earth
S0714.se: May the loving prayer of saint Bonaventure, Your confessor and bishop, not fail us, O Lord, that it may make our gifts acceptable and ever obtain for us Your pardon
S0714.pc: That Your sacrifices may give us salvation, O Lord, may blessed Bonaventure, Your confessor and bishop, we beseech You, come forward as our advocate

S0715.se: We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in commemoration of Your saints, through whom we trust to be delivered from evils both present and to come
S0715.pc: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of him in whose commemoration we have received these gifts
S0715.or: O God, Who on this day took St. Henry, Your Confessor, to the everlasting kingdom from the throne of an earthly empire; we humbly beseech You, that as You enabled him, protected by the abundance of Your grace, to overcome the temptations of the world, so grant that we, in emulation of him, may shun the allurements of this world and come to You with pure hearts.

S0816.or: O God, Who, in preference to Your other Saints, willed St. Joachim to be the father of Your Son’s Mother; grant, we beseech You, that we may ever enjoy the spiritual help of him whose feast we celebrate.
S0816.se: Graciously accept, most merciful God, the sacrifice offered to Your majesty in honor of the holy Patriarch Joachim, father of the Virgin Mary, that by his intercession, together with that of his spouse and most blessed child, we may be found worthy to obtain full forgiveness of our sins and everlasting glory.
S0816.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that by this sacrament which we have received, and by the pleading merits of holy Joachim, father of the Mother of Your beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, we may be found worthy to share Your grace in the life, and eternal glory in the life to come.

S0820.or: O God, who gave blessed Bernard to Your people as a minister of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven whom we had as the teacher of life on earth
S0820.se: Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed Bernard, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S0820.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed Bernard, Your confessor and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

S0828.or: Hearken to our supplications, almighty God, and, blessed Augustine, Your confessor and bishop, interceding, graciously grant the effect of Your wonted mercy to those to whom You give confidence to hope for Your loving-kindness
S0828.se: May the loving prayer of Your holy confessor and bishop Augustine not fail us, O Lord, that it may make our gifts acceptable and ever obtain for us Your pardon
S0828.pc: That Your sacrifices may give us salvation, O Lord, may blessed Augustine, Your confessor and bishop, we beseech You, come forward as our advocate

S0929.or: O God, Who assign according to a wondrous order the duties of Angels and men, mercifully grant that our life on earth be guarded by those who continually stand in Your presence and minister to You in heaven.
S0929.se: We offer You sacrifices of praise, O Lord, humbly praying You to accept them graciously and to grant that they may be helpful for our salvation through the intercession of the Angels who intercede for us.
S0929.pc: Relying upon the intercession of blessed Michael, Your Archangel, O Lord, we humbly pray You, that what we have received by our mouth may give grace to our mind.

S0822.or: Almighty and everlasting God, who in the Heart of the blessed Virgin Mary prepared a dwelling worthy of the Holy Spirit, mercifully grant that, keeping with devout minds the feast of her Immaculate Heart, we may be able to live according to Your heart
S0822.se: Offering to Your majesty, O Lord, the spotless Lamb, we beseech You that our hearts may be kindled by that divine fire which ineffably inflamed the Heart of the blessed Virgin Mary
S0822.pc: Refreshed with divine gifts, we humbly entreat You, O Lord, that by the intercession of the blessed Virgin Mary, whose Immaculate Heart we have venerated in this feast, we may be freed from present dangers and attain the joys of eternal life

Quad5f.or: May the blessed Virgin Mary, Your Mother, intercede for us with Your mercy, we beseech You, O Lord Jesus Christ, now and at the hour of our death, she whose most holy soul was pierced by the sword of sorrow in the hour of Your blessed passion, and gladdened with great joy in Your glorious resurrection
Quad5f.se: We offer You prayers and sacrifices, O Lord Jesus Christ, humbly beseeching You that we who by our prayers recall the piercing of the most sweet spirit of blessed Mary Your Mother may, by the manifold and most loving intercession of her and of the Saints with her beneath the Cross, have through the merits of Your death a share with the Blessed
Quad5f.pc: May the sacrifices which we have received, O Lord Jesus Christ, as we devoutly celebrate the piercing of Your Mother and Virgin, obtain for us from Your mercy the effect of every saving good

S0915.or: May the blessed Virgin Mary, Your Mother, intercede for us with Your mercy, we beseech You, O Lord Jesus Christ, now and at the hour of our death, she whose most holy soul was pierced by the sword of sorrow in the hour of Your blessed passion, and gladdened with great joy in Your glorious resurrection
S0915.se: We offer You prayers and sacrifices, O Lord Jesus Christ, humbly beseeching You that we who by our prayers recall the piercing of the most sweet spirit of blessed Mary Your Mother may, by the manifold and most loving intercession of her and of the Saints with her beneath the Cross, have through the merits of Your death a share with the Blessed
S0915.pc: May the sacrifices which we have received, O Lord Jesus Christ, as we devoutly celebrate the piercing of Your Mother and Virgin, obtain for us from Your mercy the effect of every saving good

S1006.se: We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in commemoration of Your saints, through whom we trust to be delivered from evils both present and to come
S1006.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Bruno, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity
S1006.or: May we be aided by the intercession of St. Bruno, Your Confessor, we beseech You, O Lord; that we, who have grievously offended Your Majesty by sin, may, by his merits and prayers, obtain forgiveness for our offenses.

S1019.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
S1019.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed Peter, Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity
S1019.or: O God, Who graciously made blessed Peter, Your Confessor, glorious by the gift of remarkable penance and sublime contemplation, grant, we beseech You, that, by the merit of his prayers, we may the more easily understand the things of heaven by curbing our passions.

S1102.or: O God, the creator and redeemer of all the faithful, grant to the souls of Your servants and handmaids the remission of all their sins, that by loving prayers they may obtain the pardon they have always desired
S1102.se: Look graciously, we beseech You, O Lord, on the sacrifices which we offer You for the souls of Your servants and handmaids, that to those on whom You bestowed the merit of Christian faith You may give also its reward
S1102.pc: May the prayer of Your suppliants, we beseech You, O Lord, profit the souls of Your servants and handmaids, that You may free them from all their sins and make them partakers of Your redemption

S1102_2.or: O God, the Lord of mercies, grant to the souls of Your servants and handmaids a place of refreshment, the happiness of rest and the brightness of light
S1102_2.se: Be appeased, O Lord, by our supplications for the souls of Your servants and handmaids, for whom we offer You the sacrifice of praise, that You may deign to join them to the fellowship of Your Saints
S1102_2.pc: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that the souls of Your servants and handmaids, being cleansed by this sacrifice, may obtain both pardon and everlasting rest

S1102_3.or: O God, the giver of pardon and author of man's salvation, we beseech Your mercy that, blessed Mary ever Virgin interceding with all Your Saints, You would grant the souls of Your servants and handmaids who have passed out of this world to come to the fellowship of everlasting bliss
S1102_3.se: O God, whose mercy is without measure, mercifully receive the prayers of our lowliness, and through these sacraments of our salvation grant the remission of all sins to the souls of all the faithful departed, to whom You gave the confession of Your name
S1102_3.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty and merciful God, that the souls of Your servants and handmaids, for whom we have offered this sacrifice of praise to Your majesty, may by the power of this sacrament be cleansed from all their sins and, by Your mercy, receive the happiness of everlasting light

S1104.or: Guard Your Church, O Lord, by the continual protection of saint Charles, Your confessor and bishop, that, as his pastoral care made him glorious, so his intercession may make us ever fervent in Your love
S1104.se: Grant, O merciful God, that this saving offering, by the intercession of blessed Charles, Your confessor and bishop, may ever free us from our own sins and defend us against all adversities
S1104.pc: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that the sacraments which are offered on the feast of Your saints may by their intercession become saving for us

S1111.or: O God, who see that we do not stand by any strength of our own, mercifully grant that by the intercession of blessed Martin, Your confessor and bishop, we may be defended against all adversities
S1111.se: Grant, O merciful God, that this saving offering may ever free us from our own sins and defend us against all adversities
S1111.pc: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that the sacraments which are offered on the feast of Your saints may by their intercession become saving for us

S1117.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable feast of blessed Gregory, Your confessor and bishop, may increase in us both devotion and salvation
S1117.se: May Your saints, we beseech You, O Lord, everywhere gladden us, that while we recall their merits we may feel their protection
S1117.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that, giving thanks for the gifts received, we may, by the intercession of blessed Gregory, Your confessor and bishop, receive still greater benefits

S1120.se: We offer You, O Lord, sacrifices of praise in commemoration of Your saints, through whom we trust to be delivered from evils both present and to come
S1120.pc: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of him in whose commemoration we have received these gifts
S1120.or: O God, Who by heavenly inspiration graciously called forth blessed Felix, Your Confessor, from the desert to the work of ransoming captives; grant, we beseech You, that by his intercession, and liberated by Your grace from the captivity of our sins, we may be led into our heavenly fatherland.

S1124.se: Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed John, Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
S1124.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed John, Your confessor and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty
S1124.or: O God, who made saint John, Your confessor and doctor, an outstanding lover of perfect self-denial and of the Cross, grant that, ever cleaving to his example, we may attain everlasting glory

S1125.or: O God, who gave the law to Moses on the summit of Mount Sinai, and in that same place wonderfully laid the body of blessed Catherine, Your virgin and martyr, by Your holy Angels, grant, we beseech You, that by her merits and intercession we may be able to come to the mountain which is Christ
S1125.se: May the sacrifice, O Lord, which we offer You keeping the birthday of saint Catherine, Your virgin and martyr, both loose the bonds of our wickedness and win for us the gifts of Your mercy
S1125.pc: Filled with saving mysteries, we beseech You, O Lord, that we may be helped by the prayers of her whose feast we celebrate

S1204.or: O God, who willed that blessed Peter Chrysologus, the excellent Doctor divinely foreshown, should be chosen to rule and instruct Your Church, grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven whom we had as the teacher of life on earth
S1204.se: May the loving prayer of saint Peter Chrysologus, Your bishop and doctor, not fail us, O Lord, that it may make our gifts acceptable and ever obtain for us Your pardon
S1204.pc: That Your sacrifices may give us salvation, O Lord, may blessed Peter Chrysologus, Your bishop and excellent doctor, we beseech You, come forward as our advocate

S1213.or: Hear us, O God our Saviour, that as we rejoice in the feast of blessed Lucy, Your virgin and martyr, so we may be taught the spirit of loving devotion
S1213.se: May the offering of Your consecrated people be acceptable to You, O Lord, in honor of Your saints, through whose merits they acknowledge that they have received help in tribulation
S1213.pc: You have filled Your household, O Lord, with sacred gifts; ever refresh us, we beseech You, by the intercession of her whose feast we celebrate

S1226.or: Grant us, we beseech You, O Lord, to imitate what we venerate, that we may learn to love even our enemies, since we keep the birthday of him who knew how to pray even for his persecutors to our Lord Jesus Christ Your Son; who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end
S1226.se: Receive, O Lord, these gifts in commemoration of Your saints, that, as their passion made them glorious, so our devotion may make us blameless
S1226.pc: May the mysteries we have received help us, O Lord, and, by the intercession of blessed Stephen Your martyr, strengthen us with everlasting protection

Adv2.or: Stir up our hearts, O Lord, to prepare the ways of Your only-begotten Son, so that through His coming we may be able to serve You with purified minds.
Adv2.se: Be appeased, we beseech You, O Lord, by the prayers and offerings of our human frailty, and where the support of our own merits is lacking, come to our assistance with Your protection.
Adv2.pc: We who have been refreshed by the food of spiritual nourishment, humbly beseech You, O Lord, that through partaking of this sacrament You will teach us to disdain the things of earth and love those of heaven.

Epi1.or: O Lord Jesus Christ, You Who while subject to Mary and Joseph, hallowed family life with virtues beyond description, grant us by their combined intercession, that, having been taught by the example of the Holy Family, we may attain unto their everlasting companionship.
Epi1.se: In appeasement, O Lord, we offer You this sacrifice, humbly praying that through the intercession of the Virgin Mother of God, and that of St. Joseph, You will establish our households in Your peace and grace.
Epi1.pc: Grant, Lord Jesus, that those whom You refresh with the heavenly sacrament may ever imitate the example of Your Holy Family, so that at the hour of our death, with the glorious Virgin Mary and St. Joseph welcoming us, we may be found worthy to be received into Your everlasting home.

Jan1.or: O God, who grant us to keep the eighth day from the birth of our Saviour, make us, we beseech You, to be defended by His everlasting Godhead, by whose fellowship in our flesh we have been restored
Jan1.se: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that through these gifts which we offer in the mystery of the hidden Nativity of our Lord Jesus Christ, we may obtain the understanding of a purified mind
Jan1.pc: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, that what we have received in the renewed feast of our Saviour may bring us the healing of everlasting redemption

Pent23.or: Forgive, we beseech You, O Lord, the sins of Your faithful people, so that by Your goodness we may be released from the net of sin in which we have been caught by our weakness.
Pent23.se: We offer You O Lord, the sacrifice of praise that we may serve You even better, so that You may graciously complete what You have given us, Your undeserving servants.
Pent23.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, let not human dangers overcome us to whom You grant joyful participation in things divine.

G502_3.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that You suffer not to be shaken by any disturbances us whom You have set firm on the rock of the Apostolic confession
G502_3.se: Sanctify, we beseech You, O Lord, the gift of Your people by the intercession of the Apostles, and cleanse us from the stains of our sins
G502_3.pc: Guard from all adversity, by the intercession of the Apostles, O Lord, those whom You have filled with heavenly food

ChristusRex.or: Almighty and eternal God, Who willed to restore all things in Your beloved Son, the King of the Universe, graciously grant that the peoples of the earth torn asunder by the wound of sin, may submit to His most gentle rule.
ChristusRex.se: O Lord, we offer You this sacrificial Victim of mankind's reconciliation with You; grant, we beseech You, that our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, Whom we offer in this sacrifice, may bestow upon all peoples the gifts of unity and peace.
ChristusRex.pc: We have received the food of eternal life, and we beseech You, O Lord, that we who are proud to serve under the flag of Christ the King may forever reign with Him in the Kingdom of heaven.

G491.or: O God, who gladden us by the yearly feast of Your holy martyrs Gervase and Protase, mercifully grant that we may be kindled by the example of those in whose merits we rejoice
G491.se: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts dedicated to You, and, Your holy martyrs Gervase and Protase interceding, look graciously upon us through them
G491.pc: Filled with the gift of Your salvation, we humbly pray You, O Lord, that, Your holy martyrs Gervase and Protase interceding, we may be renewed by the effect of that which we rejoice to taste

C7s.or: Hearken, O Lord, to our supplications, that we who know ourselves to be guilty by our iniquity may be delivered by the intercession of blessed N., Your martyr
C7s.se: Having received our gifts and prayers, we beseech You, O Lord, that by the intercession of blessed N., Your martyr, You would both cleanse us by heavenly mysteries and mercifully hear us
C7s.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received heavenly food may, by the intercession of blessed N., Your martyr, be thereby defended against all adversity

C11s.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who keep the feast of blessed N., Your martyr and bishop, may be helped by his intercession with You
C11s.se: May this sacrifice, we beseech You, O Lord, cleanse us from our sins, and sanctify the bodies and minds of Your servants for the celebration of the sacrifice
C11s.pc: Refreshed by partaking of the sacred gift, we beseech You, O Lord our God, that, by the intercession of blessed N., Your martyr and bishop, we may feel the effect of the rite we perform

C18s.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who keep the birthday of blessed N., Your martyr, may by his intercession be delivered from all threatening evils
C18s.se: Graciously accept, O Lord, the sacrifices dedicated to You by the merits of blessed N., Your martyr, and grant that they may avail us for everlasting help
C18s.pc: Having received the sacraments, O Lord, we beseech You that, by the intercession of blessed N., Your martyr, You may graciously hearken to our supplications

C21s.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that we who have known the glorious martyrs to be steadfast in their confession may feel them to be loving intercessors for us with You
C21s.se: May Your blessing, O Lord, come down abundantly, that, Your holy martyrs pleading, it may make our gifts acceptable to You and make for us the sacrament of redemption
C21s.pc: Refreshed with heavenly sacraments and joys, we humbly pray You, O Lord, that we may be protected by the help of those in whose triumphs we glory

C30s.or: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the venerable feast of blessed N., Your confessor and bishop, may increase in us both devotion and salvation
C30s.se: May Your saints, we beseech You, O Lord, everywhere gladden us, that while we recall their merits we may feel their protection
C30s.pc: Grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that, giving thanks for the gifts received, we may, by the intercession of blessed N., Your confessor and bishop, receive still greater benefits

C32s.or: Hear, we beseech You, O Lord, the prayers which we offer on the feast of blessed N., Your confessor and bishop, that by the merits and intercession of him who was found worthy to serve You, You may absolve us from all our sins
C32s.se: May our devotion be acceptable in Your sight, O Lord, and may it become saving for us through the supplication of him on whose feast it is offered
C32s.pc: Grant, we beseech You, O Lord, to Your faithful ever to rejoice in the veneration of Your saints and to be defended by their unceasing intercession

C35s.or: O God, who gave blessed N. to Your people as a minister of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that we may deserve to have him as our intercessor in heaven whom we had as the teacher of life on earth
C35s.se: Almighty and everlasting God, through the intercession of blessed N., Your confessor and doctor, make the gifts offered to Your majesty avail us unto everlasting salvation
C35s.pc: Receiving the sacraments of our salvation, grant, we beseech You, almighty God, that the prayer of blessed N., Your confessor and doctor, may help us everywhere, in whose veneration we have offered these gifts to Your majesty

C42s.or: Hearken, O Lord, to the prayers which we offer on the feast of blessed N., Your confessor, that we who have no confidence in our own righteousness may be helped by the prayers of him who pleased You
C42s.se: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty God, that the offering of our lowliness may be pleasing to You in honor of Your saints, and may purify us alike in body and mind
C42s.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that we who have received the food of heaven may, through the intercession of blessed N., Your confessor, be thereby defended against all adversity

C45s.or: May blessed N., virgin and martyr, we beseech You, O Lord, implore pardon for us, she who was ever pleasing to You both by the merit of her chastity and by the confession of Your power
C45s.se: Receive, O Lord, the gifts we bring on the feast of blessed N., Your virgin and martyr, by whose patronage we trust to be delivered
C45s.pc: May the mysteries we have received help us, O Lord, and, through the intercession of blessed N., Your virgin and martyr, strengthen us with everlasting protection

C48s.or: Almighty and everlasting God, who choose the weak things of the world to confound the strong, mercifully grant that we who keep the feast of blessed N., Your virgin and martyr, may feel the help of her patronage with You
C48s.se: Mercifully receive, O Lord, the sacrifices which we offer You, and, by the intercession of blessed N., Your virgin and martyr, loose the bonds of our sins
C48s.pc: Refreshed with heavenly food and drink, O our God, we humbly entreat You that we may also be defended by the prayers of her in whose commemoration we have received these gifts

C51s.or: O merciful God, enlighten the hearts of Your faithful, and by the glorious prayers of blessed N. make us despise the prosperity of the world and ever rejoice in heavenly consolation
C51s.se: We offer You, O Lord, the gifts of our devotion, that they may become pleasing to You and salutary to us through the devout supplication of blessed N.
C51s.pc: We beseech You, almighty God, that those whom You have deigned to instruct by the saving mysteries You may refresh with heavenly food through the glorious intercession of blessed N.

S0307.or: O God, who enlighten Your Church by the wonderful learning of blessed Thomas, Your confessor and doctor, and make her fruitful by his holy works, grant us, we beseech You, both to understand what he taught and to fulfil by imitation what he did
S0307.se: Recalling the memory of the Passion of Your Son, O Lord, we ask that the sacrifice which we offer You on the feast of blessed Thomas, Your confessor and doctor, may be acceptable
S0307.pc: May this holy communion, we beseech You, O Lord, gladden us, that by the prayers of blessed Thomas, Your confessor and doctor, our virtues may be strengthened within and the works of devout service may increase without
